多智能体系统

[MA-0] Premise Recovery in Software Design: What Does This Decision Rest On?

【速读】：该论文旨在解决软件架构决策记录（ADR）中前提关系隐含、难以追溯的问题，即当某项决策被撤销时，工程师需手动查找受其影响的后续决策，而若该前提未在相关ADR中显式标注，则极易遗漏。其核心挑战在于“前提恢复”（premise recovery）：在目标ADR的标识符被掩码的情况下，从早期记录中识别出与其存在依赖关系的潜在前提。解决方案的关键是利用大语言模型（LLM）进行自动化前提识别，通过对比7个开源权重模型与2个无LLM基线方法，发现Qwen3.8-27B模型在F1分数上达到0.756，显著优于基于词重叠的基线方法（F1=0.466），尤其在标题几乎无重叠的情况下仍能有效识别隐含前提（召回率达0.758）。研究还表明，推理能力可提升对隐含前提的召回率，但对整体F1贡献有限；此外，仅在部分超期替换场景中发现了少量过时依赖项，表明多数前提关系虽未显式记录，但实际存在且可通过开放模型有效推断，从而在决策回溯时提供高精度（0.68–0.78）的未写明前提建议。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21367
作者: Priyabanta Sandulua,Islam Mesabaha,Sebastian J. Vollmer
机构: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)(德国人工智能研究中心); University of Kaiserslautern-Landau (RPTU)(凯撒斯劳滕-兰道大学)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Design decisions shape software architecture, and writing them down preserves the reasons behind it. Architecture decision records (ADRs) capture them, each with its context, choice, and consequences. A decision can depend on earlier ones: reversing one of them would force its review. We call these its premises. Yet ADRs do not always name their premises. When a decision is reversed, engineers supersede its ADR and search by hand for what it affects. That search can miss ADRs resting on an unnamed premise. We frame this as premise recovery: given an ADR with identifiers masked, find its premises among earlier records. We collect 1,060 ADRs from 36 repositories and label 1,529 candidate pairs for 60 target ADRs. Two LLM annotators agree at \kappa = 0.859. An independent human annotator, blind to their labels, agrees with the stated/implicit tag on 30 of 32 premises (\kappa = 0.875). We compare 7 open-weight models with 2 baselines that use no LLM. Qwen3.8-27B reaches F1 0.756, against 0.466 for word overlap; 2 models added post hoc score similarly. On the 11 premises whose titles barely overlap the target, it finds 0.758, while word overlap finds none. Reasoning raises its recall of implicit premises but not its F1. Word overlap with as many predictions gains 69% as much. We find only 2 to 3 stale dependents, though we searched for unlinked ones in only 30 of 66 supersessions. Open models could thus suggest unwritten premises when a decision is reversed, with precision between 0.68 and 0.78.

[MA-1] Even Loose Proximity Constraints Make Makespan-optimal Unlabeled Multi-agent Pathfinding Hard

【速读】：该论文旨在解决r-连通无标签多智能体路径规划问题（r-Connected Unlabeled Multi-agent Pathfinding, r CUMAPF），即在图G中，多个可互换的智能体需在始终保持彼此通信范围（距离不超过r）的前提下，形成一个连通的整体并完成路径规划。传统多智能体路径规划（MAPF）无法建模此类邻近性约束，而该问题在自重构与车队编队等实际应用中具有重要意义。针对最小化完成时间（makespan）的最优解求解问题，已有研究表明当r=1时问题为NP-hard，而当r足够大时存在多项式时间解法，但中间情形（2≤r）的复杂性长期未知。本文通过证明：当2≤r=O(|V|¹⁻ε)（其中0<ε≤1为固定常数，|V|为顶点数）时，寻找使完成时间至多为2的r CUMAPF解属于NP-hard，从而显著缩小了该问题复杂性的研究空白。其核心贡献在于揭示了在中等通信半径下问题的计算难度，并进一步推导出有标签版本的r CUMAPF在同一条件下同样为NP-hard。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21277
作者: Takahiro Suzuki,Keisuke Okumura
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study \textsc r -Connected Unlabeled Multi-agent Pathfinding ( r CUMAPF), a variant of MAPF where interchangeable agents have a proximity range r\in \mathbbN , and agents must form a single group in a given graph G through limited-range communication at all times. The problem arises in fundamental applications such as self-reconfiguration and platooning, while standard MAPF does not capture proximity constraints. For the problem of finding a makespan-optimal solution, prior work shows \NP-hardness for r=1 and polynomial-time solvability when r is sufficiently large; the complexity for the intermediate case 2\le r is largely unknown. To narrow this gap, we show that finding a solution to r CUMAPF with makespan at most 2 is \NP-hard for 2\le r= O(|V|^1-\varepsilon) , where 0\varepsilon\le 1 is a fixed constant and |V| is the number of vertices. As a consequence, we show that the labeled analogue of r CUMAPF is also \NP-hard under the same condition.

[MA-2] Evaluating Authorization and Trust Boundaries in Agent ic Orchestration Frameworks

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI (Generative AI) 系统在多智能体协作、工具调用与记忆管理等编排边界引入的安全风险问题。其核心挑战在于：如何在跨组件的交互中有效保障身份表示、操作授权及指令与信息传播的可信性。研究通过在 gpt-4o-mini 模型上对 LangChain、LangGraph、AutoGen 与 OpenClaw 四个框架进行十二项实验，基于《面向生成式应用的 OWASP Top 10》框架评估了提示注入、未授权资源访问与命令执行、记忆污染以及跨智能体信任与身份伪造等攻击面。关键发现表明，工具链式调用、过期文件系统验证、编码指令传递及跨智能体委托机制暴露了组件间授权控制的薄弱环节；同时，未经验证的状态可影响系统响应，构成独立于传统访问控制失效的“记忆污染”风险。解决方案的关键在于构建显式的权限控制、受控的能力分配、文件系统隔离与执行防护机制，强调必须在整个智能体工作流中持续维护授权与信息信任边界，而非依赖框架功能或模型层指令作为安全保证。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21259
作者: Sahaya Jestus Lazer,Kshitiz Aryal,Maanak Gupta,Elisa Bertino
机构: Tennessee Tech University(田纳西理工大学); University of Nebraska Omaha(内布拉斯加大学奥马哈分校); Purdue University(普渡大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic AI systems extend large language models with tools, memory, and multi-agent collaboration, introducing security risks at orchestration boundaries. These risks depend on how identities are represented, operations are authorized, and instructions or information propagate between components. We evaluate LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and OpenClaw through twelve experiments mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications using a common LLM (gpt-4o-mini). The experiments cover prompt injection, unauthorized resource access and command execution, memory poisoning, and inter-agent trust and identity attacks. Adversarial inputs induced unauthorized tool invocation, while tool chaining, stale filesystem validation, encoded instructions, and inter-agent delegation exposed weaknesses in authorization across component boundaries. Memory poisoning showed that untrusted state can influence responses, a risk distinct from conventional access-control violations. In the evaluated protected configurations, explicit authorization, controlled capability assignment, filesystem containment, and execution safeguards prevented specific unauthorized operations. The findings emphasize preserving authorization and information-trust boundaries throughout agentic workflows rather than treating framework capabilities or model-level instructions as sufficient security guarantees.

[MA-3] Stream of Belief: Eliciting Collective Intelligence through Latent Belief Dynamics

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体推理中因缺乏有效信念协同机制而导致的推理效率低下与泛化能力不足的问题。其核心挑战在于如何实现智能体间在复杂任务中的动态信念对齐，以达成一致且稳定的集体推理结果。解决方案的关键在于提出“信念流”（Stream of Belief, SoB）框架，该框架通过让智能体持续维护并迭代更新隐式潜在信念（latent beliefs），并借助通信与反思机制不断优化信念状态，最终收敛至一个不再发生有意义信息传播的集体信念均衡态。这一方法突破了传统离散决策或固定交互模式的局限，从信念动力学（belief dynamics）视角为多智能体系统的可扩展推理提供了新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21250
作者: Yu Yao,Jiayi Dong,Yilun Du
机构: MIT(麻省理工学院); UCLA(加州大学洛杉矶分校); Harvard(哈佛大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In this work, we view multi-agent reasoning as a process of seeking a collective equilibrium of implicit belief dynamics and introduce Stream of Belief (SoB), where agents maintain continuous latent beliefs and iteratively refine them through communication and reflection. Our method seeks a collective belief state of a multi-agent system where further communication induces no meaningful information propagation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the generalization of SoB across tasks and model families. More Broadly, our results suggest a new perspective on scaling multi-agent reasoning from belief dynamics.

[MA-4] Language-model agents beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型代理（language-model agents）在接收真实信息片段时，仍可能因自我构建关联而产生错误信念并传播谣言的问题，即“叙事过拟合”（narrative overfitting）。其核心挑战在于：即使输入信息本身为真，代理在填补信息空白时基于认知惯性构建的内在叙事关系可能被误认为事实，从而导致对虚假叙事的高接受度。解决方案的关键在于引入“生成蒙太奇”（Generative Montage）机制，通过协调多个代理将真实信息片段重新组织成具有误导性的连贯叙事，从而模拟和量化这一认知漏洞。研究发现，在六次推特事件中的1,090个谣言目标上，多数模型对谣言的接受率超过65%，且即使经过多数投票或证据复核，接受率仍高于50%，表明错误可有效传递至下游决策。为解释此现象，研究采用片段干预与合成对照实验，揭示信念影响与证据支持之间的分离机制。据此提出“有根监控器”（Grounded Monitor），一种基于神经符号的运行时监控框架，通过实时检验推理链条中每一步是否具备直接证据支持，从而抑制无根据的推断。该方法在原始与匿名场景下均使决策准确率提升5.6至29.0个百分点，验证了在代理生成结论前对隐含关系进行可解释性审查的有效性，为防范生成式AI中的认知性谣言传播提供了关键路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21235
作者: Jinwei Hu,Qisong He,Xinmiao Huang,Youcheng Sun,Yi Dong,Xiaowei Huang
机构: University of Liverpool; Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI)
备注: Under Review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language-model agents’ beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents’ judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.

[MA-5] CoopDistill: Equilibrium-Guided Multi-Agent Policy Distillation for Cooperative Driving

【速读】：该论文旨在解决协同驾驶中多车联合决策的效率与安全性难题，尤其针对传统基于优化的方法因固定路径而限制空间灵活性，以及多智能体强化学习（MARL）在协调学习与安全执行方面面临的挑战。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于均衡引导的多智能体策略蒸馏框架——CoopDistill。该方法的关键在于：首先采用势博弈（Potential Game, PG）构建纵向参考路径，提供稳定的安全约束；在此基础上，通过残差式MARL学习纵向加速度、冲突接近时机及横向路径修正，以增强动态适应性；同时引入硬案例课程（hard-case curriculum）聚焦于PG难以处理或延迟严重的交互场景，提升探索效率；最后，通过对比滚动选择器（comparative rollout selector）评估学习到的协同修正方案与PG基准之间的联合效果，择优执行。该设计显著提升了协同驾驶在复杂交通场景下的成功率与通行效率，且未出现碰撞事件。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21069
作者: Shiyu Fang,Sheng Zhao,Jiarui Zhang,Chengkai Xu,Xiaocong Zhao,Peng Hang,Jian Sun
机构: Tongji University (同济大学)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cooperative driving extends autonomous driving from individual vehicle decisions to joint maneuvers that improve traffic safety and efficiency. Optimization-based methods impose safety constraints but often fix paths to simplify multi-vehicle planning, limiting spatial flexibility. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) explores alternatives through interaction, but coordinated learning and safe execution remain challenging. Their integration nevertheless faces challenges in exploration efficiency, experience allocation, and execution reliability. To address these challenges, this paper proposes CoopDistill, an equilibrium-guided multi-agent policy distillation framework. A potential-game (PG) formulation provides a fixed-path longitudinal reference, around which a residual MARL policy learns longitudinal acceleration, conflict-approach timing, and lateral path corrections. A hard-case curriculum concentrates experience on interactions that PG leaves unresolved or substantially delayed. A comparative rollout selector evaluates the joint consequences of learned corrections against PG before choosing the executed action. Experiments in merging, roundabout, and intersection scenarios compare CoopDistill with six baselines at four connected automated vehicle penetration levels. Relative to PG, success improves by 2.1–27.1 percentage points and delay decreases by 7.3–27.3%, with no observed collisions. Code is available at this https URL

[MA-6] OpenMAS-GApp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Domain-Adaptive Multi-Agent Application Construction

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（Multi-Agent System, MAS）跨领域应用构建中因任务规范、组件资源与执行环境不一致而导致的可比性差与泛化能力弱的问题。现有研究虽在智能体生成、架构设计、工作流构建及组件选择等方面取得进展，但各自独立发展且评估条件差异显著，难以实现统一比较或跨域应用。为此，本文提出OpenMAS-GApp——一个面向多领域通用的MAS应用构建基准平台，通过标准化任务输入、组件资源、构建接口与执行环境，实现了在一致条件下对不同构建方法的评估。其核心解决方案在于引入Graph Harness作为参考构建方法，该方法能够基于任务依赖关系推导，自动选择兼容的智能体与工具，并将其交互组织为可执行的图结构，从而实现高效、可扩展的MAS系统构造。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20997
作者: Xunkai Li,Kairui Yang,Jiaxi Li,Yuecong Mao,Zekai Chen,Xinle Zhang,Rong-Hua Li,Guoren Wang
机构: Beijing Institute of Technology (北京理工大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Constructing multi-agent system (MAS) applications across domains requires translating diverse requirements into executable systems, involving task decomposition, agent and tool selection, and execution organization. Existing studies have explored individual aspects of MAS construction, including agent generation, architecture design, workflow generation, and component selection. However, these methods are often developed and evaluated independently, using different task specifications, component resources, and execution settings. This makes it difficult to compare their construction capabilities or determine how they can be applied to different domains. To address this problem, we propose OpenMAS-GApp, a One-for-All benchmark for MAS application construction across diverse domains. It standardizes task inputs, component resources, construction interfaces, and execution environments to support MAS construction under consistent conditions. Within OpenMAS-GApp, we provide Graph Harness as a reference construction method that derives task dependencies, selects compatible agents and tools, and organizes their interactions into executable graphs. We evaluate construction methods across 19 benchmark datasets under 20 evaluation settings spanning four application types and four professional domains.

[MA-7] Hivemind: A Federated Protocol for AI-Mediated Tacit Knowledge Sharing in Organisations

【速读】：该论文旨在解决企业在人工智能（AI）辅助工作场景中普遍存在的隐性知识（tacit knowledge）难以跨团队、跨部门高效流动的问题。尽管现有集中式知识库和智能工具已部分缓解知识共享瓶颈，但其在捕捉与传递个体决策过程、推理逻辑及上下文背景等隐性知识方面仍存在结构性缺陷。为此，论文提出Hivemind协议，其核心解决方案是基于野中郁次郎与竹内弘一（1995）提出的SECI模型（社会化、外化、综合、内化），构建一种去中心化的联邦架构，使AI代理能够在无需直接人类干预的前提下，异步地交换各自用户所积累的隐性知识。该方案通过分布式记忆系统实现知识的动态聚合与再利用，突破了传统知识管理系统的边界限制。研究采用设计科学方法论（Design Science Research, DSR）验证了原型系统的可行性，但企业层面的联邦隐性知识共享效益评估仍需未来进一步探索。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20988
作者: Srinivasan Sundaresan(Rakuten Group, Inc.)
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 30 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper presents Hivemind, a federated protocol that enables AI agents to exchange tacit knowledge on behalf of their users, asynchronously and without requiring any direct human interaction. Individual AI memory systems capture the decisions, reasoning, and contextual knowledge that surface during AI-assisted work. Hivemind creates the shared space in which this captured knowledge can flow between individuals across team and departmental boundaries, addressing a structural gap that neither centralised knowledge repositories nor existing AI tooling closes, even where partial solutions such as expert-finding systems exist. The paper evaluates centralised versus decentralised design approaches, proposes a federated architecture grounded in Nonaka and Takeuchi’s (1995) Socialisation, Externalisation, Combination and Internalisation (SECI) model, and demonstrates a proof-of-concept implementation using Design Science Research (DSR) methodology. Measuring the enterprise benefit of federated tacit expertise sharing remains an open task for future work.

[MA-8] From Vision to Interaction: Evaluating Dynamic Social Intelligence of VLM Agents in ALIVE-World

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前人工智能（AI）代理在真实社会场景中缺乏动态社会智能评估体系的问题。现有评价方法将社会智能割裂为文本抽象、静态推理任务或缺乏社会动态性的具身模拟器，无法捕捉真实人际互动中多模态、连续性和交互性的复杂特征。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个名为ALIVE-World的具身仿真环境，支持以第一人称视觉、语言和非言语行为为核心的多模态动态交互，并引入基于个体属性条件化的双系统架构（直觉-情感与逻辑-认知）驱动的对等智能体，实现社会情境下的真实反馈。在此基础上，提出ALIVE-Bench评测框架，通过深度利用环境状态与智能体内部变量，从感知、理解、影响与结果四个维度系统量化评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）代理的社会智能水平。研究揭示动态社会智能具有高度多维性与场景依赖性，识别出上游感知与下游社会干预之间存在关键瓶颈，暴露出VLM在精细空间距离意识、适应性干预策略及多方协同方面的固有缺陷，从而为多模态智能体未来的行为对齐提供了可操作的改进方向。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20956
作者: Yue Xu,Xiaoyu Qin,Sihan Zhao,Ze-en Xiong,Jia Jia
机构: Tsinghua University (清华大学); BNRist (清华信息科学与技术国家实验室); Key Laboratory of Pervasive Computing, Ministry of Education (普适计算教育部重点实验室)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26), Oral Presentation, Outstanding Paper Award

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As AI agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications and take on social roles, dynamic social intelligence, the ability to continuously perceive multimodal cues, infer latent cognitive states, intervene through embodied actions, and ultimately achieve social goals, has become essential. However, existing evaluations largely fragment social intelligence into text-based abstractions, static reasoning tasks, or embodied simulators that lack social dynamics. These approaches fail to capture the multimodal, continuous, and interpersonal complexity of authentic human interactions. To bridge this gap, we introduce ALIVE-World, an embodied simulation environment supporting dynamic multimodal interactions encompassing egocentric vision, language, and non-verbal action. To provide socially grounded interactive feedback, we populate this environment with counterpart agents driven by a profile-conditioned, dual-system (intuitive-affective and logical-cognitive) architecture. Building upon this platform, we propose ALIVE-Bench to transform the assessment of social intelligence into a trackable quantitative framework. By deeply leveraging underlying environmental states and agents’ internal variables, ALIVE-Bench systematically evaluates Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents across four critical dimensions: perception, understanding, influence, and outcome. Extensive evaluations reveal that dynamic social intelligence is fundamentally multi-dimensional and scenario-dependent. We identify a critical bottleneck between upstream perception and downstream social intervention, exposing VLM vulnerabilities in fine-grained proxemic awareness, adaptive intervention, and multi-party coordination. By uncovering these limitations and the diverse interaction strategies they produce, this benchmark provides actionable insights for the future behavioral alignment of multimodal agents.

[MA-9] LEDGER: Auditable Agent Memory Under Change

【速读】：该论文旨在解决现有代理记忆系统在实际应用中面临的核心挑战：动态环境下的事实变更、信息源可信度差异以及用户对遗忘操作的需求。传统方法通常基于固定历史进行评估，仅关注最终答案的准确性，忽视了记忆内容的时效性、来源可信度与可删除性等关键属性。为此，本文提出LEDGER——一种基于语言模型生成事实并由显式规则决定当前有效值、信任源及执行删除操作的记忆层架构。每个事实均附带其来源和有效时间段，实现可追溯、可验证的动态记忆管理。在此基础上，LEDGER+EP引入对原始对话轮次的搜索机制，在记忆未覆盖问题时进行补充检索，并在删除操作时同步清理相关上下文，进一步提升系统的鲁棒性与效率。实验表明，在合成多会话编程任务中，LEDGER+EP在回退模式下于五个开发种子上达到94.3%的准确率（五组保留种子为91.1%），显著优于最强基线全历史重放（82.1%与83.3%）；当用户仅描述需删除的事实时，被删除内容未在任何探测中返回至系统证据链。在LongMemEval子集上，LEDGER+EP以1%的上下文开销实现了与全历史重放相当的74.8%准确率，充分体现了其高效性。解决方案的关键在于将显式规则与可追踪的事实元数据相结合，实现对记忆的动态控制与精确管理。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20927
作者: Md Aidul Islam,Md Nasir Uddin Shuvo,Muhammad Waseem,Pekka Abrahamsson
机构: Tampere University (坦佩雷大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Performance (cs.PF); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agent memory systems are mostly evaluated on fixed histories, and only their final answers are scored. In real use, facts change, sources differ in reliability, and users ask the agent to forget things. We present LEDGER, a memory layer in which a language model proposes facts and explicit rules decide which value is current, which source to trust, and what to delete. Each fact keeps its source and the period in which it held. LEDGER+EP adds a search over raw conversation turns for questions the ledger does not cover, and scrubs these turns on deletion. We compare both against no memory, full-history replay, retrieval over raw transcripts, and Mem0, with the same answering model and prompt, on a synthetic multi-session coding-agent workload and a 210-question subset of LongMemEval, and we score both the evidence each memory sends to the model and the answer. On the coding workload, LEDGER+EP in fallback mode answers 94.3% of questions correctly on five development seeds and 91.1% on five held-out seeds, against 82.1% and 83.3% for full replay, the strongest baseline. When a deletion request only describes the fact, no deleted value reached our systems’ evidence in any evaluated probe. On LongMemEval, LEDGER+EP in augment mode has the same observed accuracy as full replay (74.8%) with 1% of its context. The main limitation is that the coding workload is synthetic and built by us; on LongMemEval, the differences between the strongest systems are within the confidence intervals.

[MA-10] When Does Interaction Help? Toward a Reynolds Number for Collective Intelligence

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中交互行为对集体智能性能影响的预测问题，核心在于识别在何种条件下交互能够提升整体表现，而非引入误差或抑制有用差异。其关键解决方案是探索是否存在少数无量纲参数（类似雷诺数）可统一描述不同群体规模、网络结构与任务类型下的交互增益，从而建立一种低维相似性法则。研究通过分布式分类任务、随机追踪网络及神经元细胞自动机等模型，结合解析与实证分析，发现仅基于三阶联合矩等统计特征无法普遍确定交互增益的正负；即使在匹配候选参数的情况下，因任务功率分布于不同频谱模式，仍可能出现增益反转。然而，在任务谱集中且观测噪声对齐的条件下，研究推导出一个低维相似关系，并给出无延迟误差的显式上界，该关系在固定协议下跨网络规模与拓扑结构得到验证。相比之下，神经元细胞自动机系统不适用此关系，且基于矩的预测器在相同样本预算下表现劣于直接测量增益。结果表明，尽管存在特定条件下的低维预测可行性，但普遍意义上的类雷诺数描述仍待突破，揭示了集体智能中交互增益预测的边界与局限。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20773
作者: Xuening Wu,Haode Yang,Yanlan Kang,Shenqin Yin
机构: Pfizer Inc.(辉瑞公司); Fudan University(复旦大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent systems combine distributed information through interaction, which can improve performance but also spread errors or suppress useful differences. Predicting when interaction helps is central to understanding and designing collective intelligence. We investigate whether a few dimensionless parameters can predict gains over explicitly defined non-communicating baselines across group sizes, network structures, and tasks, toward a Reynolds-number-like description of collective intelligence. Using distributed classification tasks, stochastic tracking networks, and neural cellular automata, we combine analytical and empirical evidence to examine information sufficiency, dynamical applicability, and finite-sample prediction. We construct inference systems with bounded random variables and matching specified joint moments up to total degree three, yet opposite interaction gains under a fixed readout. These moments alone cannot generally determine the gain sign. Tracking networks likewise exhibit gain reversals despite matched candidate parameters when task power occupies different spectral modes. Under concentrated task spectra and aligned observation noise, however, we derive a low-dimensional similarity relation with an explicit zero-delay error bound and test it across network sizes and topologies under frozen protocols. The relation does not directly apply to the neural cellular systems, where a separate moment-based predictor underperforms direct gain measurement at matched calibration sample budgets. These results establish conditions and limits for low-dimensional gain prediction, providing a restricted similarity law while leaving a general Reynolds-number-like description of collective intelligence open.

[MA-11] Learning Design Taste through Verifiable Synthetic Environments and Agent ic Reinforcement Learning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式代码语言模型在生成用户界面时普遍存在的设计质量缺陷问题，即界面在层级结构、间距、排版和整体构图等方面表现不佳。其核心挑战在于如何让小型代码模型通过学习获得“设计品味”（design taste），而传统方法难以有效评估和优化此类非功能性设计属性。解决方案的关键在于构建一个基于可验证合成环境的强化学习框架，包含三个核心组件：首先，提出一种分层验证框架，将设计质量分解为硬性约束、基于渲染的度量指标、评分表判官、组内相对偏好以及盲测专家评审，并引入“准入协议”筛选仅符合专家共识、因果敏感性、抗欺骗性及稳定性要求的奖励信号；其次，借鉴SCALER方法，设计参数化生成的合成设计环境，通过语法树扰动算子与约束采样器生成具有难度阶梯特征的页面实例，并采用自适应课程学习与隔离规则防止奖励过拟合；最后，使用40亿参数的代码模型在多轮交互中执行代理式强化学习，自主编辑代码库并读取自身渲染结果的文本报告，由隐藏评分者计算奖励。实验表明，该方法在TD-Bench上使“设计品味指数”（Taste Index）在家族内提升至0.795，跨家族测试提升至0.700，且在盲测专家对比中分别以0.600和0.569胜过基线模型与单轮控制组。研究发现，性能优势主要依赖于推理时的迭代反馈循环，但跨类别独特性略有下降，未完全达成既定目标。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20612
作者: Sujay choubey,Siddhant Saxena,Sarthak Kapil,Suhas Motwani
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注: 15 pages, 9 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Code-generating language models produce user interfaces that build and run, but the pages are often weak in hierarchy, spacing, typography and composition. We study whether a small code model can learn design taste through reinforcement learning in verifiable synthetic environments. The method has three components. First, a layered verification framework splits design quality into hard gates, render-grounded metrics, rubric judges, within-group relative preference and a blinded expert panel. A signal enters the reward only if it passes an admission protocol that tests agreement with experts, causal sensitivity, resistance to hack traps and stability. Second, following SCALER [1], synthetic design environments are parameterised generators with measured difficulty ladders: base pages are written once by an agentic coder, and instances are produced by syntax-tree perturbation operators and constraint samplers, scheduled by an adaptive curriculum with a quarantine rule against reward over-optimisation. Third, a 4B code model is trained with agentic reinforcement learning over multi-turn episodes in which it edits and builds a repository and reads a textual report of its own render, while hidden graders compute the reward. The admission protocol admits 7 of 16 render signals and 6 of 10 rubric dimensions. On TD-Bench, agentic training raises the Taste Index from 0.630 to 0.795 in-family and from 0.598 to 0.700 on held-out families, and wins 0.600 of blinded expert comparisons against the base model and 0.569 against a single-turn control. Most of the advantage depends on the inference-time loop, and cross-brief distinctiveness falls slightly below that of the base model, the only success criterion not met.

[MA-12] Who Observes Whom: Network Rationalizability and Its Complexity

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在信息部分且不对称的观测网络（observation network）背景下，如何定义和分析博弈中策略选择的合理解集问题。传统上，纳什均衡（Nash equilibrium）假设玩家完全知晓对手的策略，而理性化（rationalizability）则仅依赖于共同知识的理性假设，二者处于信息极端。当玩家间观测关系由有向图 $ G $ 描述（边 $ i \to j $ 表示玩家 $ i $ 观测到玩家 $ j $ 的策略），传统的解概念不再适用。为此，作者提出“自维持”（self-sustaining）这一新解概念：一个策略组合集合若满足其中每个策略组合对所有玩家而言，均可通过来自同一集合的推测（conjecture）得到合理解释，并与玩家实际观测一致，则该集合为自维持的。其解决方案的关键在于引入两种类型的推测——点推测（point conjectures，即单一策略组合）和信念推测（belief conjectures，即策略组合上的概率分布），并研究它们在不同网络拓扑下的行为特性。结果表明，随着观测边的增加，解集单调缩小；在无边网络下，解可多项式时间求解；而在存在单边观测时，问题变为 PPAD\mathsf{PPAD}PPAD-难，且在单向两玩家监控情形下，被观测方的策略恰好为其纳什均衡策略。对于层级型网络（如传递性锦标赛），成员判定可通过递归简化至子博弈，验证可在 ∃R\exists\mathbb{R}∃R 中完成，且在双人情形下属于 P\mathsf{P}P；而在有向三元环结构中，迭代消除过程可能永不终止，且点推测下某些内部预测仅能通过无限见证集表示，而信念推测则可避免此类病态现象。最后，当仅可观测实际纯策略行动时，解集非空当且仅当网络无边，且此时可在 $ O(n|A|^2) $ 时间内计算得出。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20110
作者: Mojtaba Fayaz-Bakhsh,MohammadAmin Fazli
机构: 未知
类目: Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Computational Complexity (cs.CC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Theoretical Economics (econ.TH)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Nash equilibrium and rationalizability sit at opposite informational extremes: the former presumes that each player knows all opponents’ strategies, the latter that players reason from common knowledge of rationality alone. When visibility is partial and asymmetric, we study the solution concepts induced by a directed \emphobservation network G in which an edge i\to j means that i observes j 's strategy. A set of profiles is \emphself-sustaining if every profile in it can be justified, for every player, by conjectures from the same set that agree with everything the player observes. We consider \emphpoint conjectures (single profiles) and \emphbelief conjectures (distributions over profiles). Both range from Nash equilibrium on the complete network to point- and correlated rationalizability on the empty network, and shrink monotonically as links are added. Network topology governs both behavior and complexity. A predicted profile can be found in polynomial time on the empty network, whereas a single link makes search \mathsfPPAD -hard: under one-sided two-player monitoring, the observed player’s strategies are exactly her Nash equilibrium strategies. On hierarchical networks (transitive tournaments), membership reduces recursively to smaller games and admits polynomial-size certificates, placing verification in \exists\mathbbR , and in \mathsfP for two players. On the directed three-cycle, however, iterated elimination may never terminate under either variant, and under point conjectures interior predictions may admit only infinite witness sets, a pathology that belief conjectures avoid in the same game. Finally, when only realized pure actions are observed, the solution set is guaranteed to be non-empty exactly when the network has no edges, and is computable in time O(n|A|^2) . [MA-13] Infrastructure-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Attention for Highway Ramp Merging

【速读】：该论文旨在解决高速公路上匝道合流（on-ramp merging）场景中因缺乏有效协同而导致的安全性下降与通行效率降低的问题。在密集交通条件下，传统方法或仅依赖局部邻近车辆信息，导致决策局部最优；或采用全局交通状态观测，引入大量无关信息，影响决策效率。针对这一挑战，本文提出一种基于Transformer的多智能体强化学习（MARL）车辆控制模型，其核心创新在于引入一种基于注意力机制的观测编码器，使每辆联网自动驾驶汽车（CAV）能够从由路侧基础设施通过车-路通信（V2I）提供的全局交通状态中，动态筛选出对自身决策具有相关性的车辆信息。该方案实现了全局信息感知与局部信息聚焦之间的平衡。实验结果表明，所提模型在SUMO仿真中显著优于三种基线方法：仅观测邻车、全量信息编码及规则式SUMO模型，在交通流量、安全性与行驶平稳性方面均表现最佳；在四小时动态需求仿真中，该模型成功避免了拥堵，而其他模型在高密度下失效。此外，模型在存在人类驾驶车辆及真实V2I通信误差的情况下仍能保持无碰撞和高吞吐性能，且可视化分析揭示了智能体在不同交通情境下对其他车辆的相关性权重分配机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20078
作者: Chenhao Tong,Steffen Müller
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:On-ramp merging is a typical safety and throughput problem on highways. Without proper coordination, human drivers and self-interested autonomous vehicles may make risky manoeuvres and cause accidents or congestion. With recent advances in connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), vehicles can be trained to coordinate for safe and efficient merging. However, in dense traffic, forming an effective observation of the traffic state is challenging. For example, observing only the neighbouring vehicles may lead to locally optimal decisions, while observing the entire traffic can introduce much irrelevant information. In this paper, we propose a transformer-based MARL vehicle control model to address these problems. A roadside infrastructure controller receives the states of all CAVs via vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication and sends control commands back to them. An attention-based observation encoder is designed where each vehicle can filter the relevant vehicle information from the global traffic state. The proposed model is evaluated in SUMO against three baselines: a model that observes only the neighbouring vehicles, a model that encodes the global traffic information, and the rule-based SUMO model. The results show that our model achieves the highest traffic flow, safety and smoothness. Furthermore, in a four-hour simulation with dynamic traffic demand, our model successfully avoids traffic jams, while other baseline models fail at high traffic flow. We also show that our model remains effective when human-driven vehicles are present. We further show that our model, trained in ideal communication conditions, can still remain collision-free and maintain throughput under realistic V2I communication errors. Finally, we visualise the relevance weights that an ego vehicle assigns to other vehicles in multiple traffic situations.

[MA-14] World-Model-Guided Plan Search for Cooperative Mixed-Traffic Control at Bottlenecks

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在车道缩减瓶颈处，通过联网与自动化车辆（Connected and Automated Vehicles, CAVs）进行协作式车速控制以缓解交通拥堵的问题，尤其关注车辆角色分配、执行时机及初始排队成本与后续通行效益之间的权衡。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种结合世界模型引导与仿真验证的离线规划搜索框架：利用融合物理动态特性的交通世界模型，指导对车辆角色、目标速度、等待时长及启动时间等参数的进化搜索；并通过与SUMO仿真器配对的筛选机制，评估候选方案在总延误降低和各车辆组平均延误增量（不超过10秒）方面的表现。最终生成可复用的规划库，其动作可临时覆盖冻结的MAPPO策略，实现高效协同控制。实验结果表明，在60%渗透率、每小时2800辆车的交通需求下，该方法相较MAPPO策略减少平均总延误14.3%，优于人工编写规划库的3.8%改善，且最大组平均延误增加仅6.2秒，低于预设阈值。此外，基于世界模型引导的搜索在独立筛选中成功率达30.0%，远高于随机采样的2.6%，验证了预测性搜索与独立验证在满足群体延迟约束条件下发现有效协同策略的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20067
作者: Jinghan Peng,Ning Liu,Xiangrui Kong,Sen Shen,Dongkun Han
机构: University of California, Los Angeles (加州大学洛杉矶分校); The University of Western Australia (西澳大学); The Chinese University of Hong Kong (香港中文大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 8 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cooperative speed control by connected and automated vehicles can reduce congestion at lane drop bottlenecks. However, effective coordination depends on vehicle roles and execution timing, while initial holding costs may be offset by later traffic benefits. This paper proposes an offline plan search framework that combines world model guidance with simulator verification. A traffic world model incorporating physical dynamics guides evolutionary search over vehicle roles, target speeds, holding durations, and start times. Paired SUMO simulations screen candidates for total delay reduction and limits on additional mean delay across vehicle groups. Accepted plans form a reusable library whose actions temporarily override a frozen MAPPO policy. Across 192 paired test scenarios at 60% penetration and a demand of 2,800 vehicles per hour, the searched library reduces mean total delay by 14.3% relative to MAPPO and by 3.8% relative to a handwritten plan library. The largest increase in group mean delay is 6.2 s, below the prescribed 10 s limit. In a separate screening experiment, the guided search achieves a 30.0% pass rate compared with 2.6% for random sampling. These results support the use of predictive search and independent verification for discovering cooperative plans under group delay constraints.

[MA-15] Autonomous Multi-modal Agents for ITOps Observability

【速读】：该论文旨在解决IT运维可观测性（ITOps observability）工具与系统间数据孤岛问题，即如何高效集成多源异构数据以支持统一的可观测性分析。其核心解决方案是提出一种多模态多智能体系统——ITOps Observability Studio，通过协作式AI智能体实现可观测性工作流的自动化编排。该系统的创新关键在于三层次架构设计：第一层为智能体间的协同通信机制；第二层为基于大语言模型（LLM）的专用智能体，分别负责数据访问、模式操作（schema operations）与可视化生成；第三层为统一的工具集成接口。系统实现了自然语言到GraphQL的转换、自动化的GraphQL模式生成与映射、链路追踪数据全生命周期管理以及跨工具的可靠性工程工作流支持。此外，所有智能体均内嵌智能体分析（agent analytics）功能，可追踪模型调用与工具调用行为，从而支持可解释性与故障诊断。评估表明，当前基于开源模型的查询生成与路由性能良好，数据生命周期管理智能体在多数场景下表现有效；同时，联合测试揭示了仅在提示词（prompt）、解析器与服务栈共同作用时才会显现的缺陷，并提供了相应的修复方案。

Abstract:ITOps observability products must integrate data from different tools and systems. We present ITOps Observability Studio, a multi-modal multi-agent system that orchestrates observability workflows through collaborative AI agents. Its three-tier architecture features inter-agent communication, specialized LLM-powered agents for data access, schema operations and visualization, and unified tool integration. The system supports natural language to GraphQL translation, GraphQL schema generation, schema mapping, trace data lifecycle management and multi-tool workflows for reliability engineering. Its agents are instrumented with agent analytics, so that their model and tool calls can be traced. We evaluate each agent on its own benchmark, scored against gold answers where they exist and by a model judge for schema mapping and chart quality. Query generation on a public benchmark and routing work well with a current open model, and the data lifecycle management agent solves most of its scenarios. The evaluation exposed defects that only appear when prompts, parsers and serving stacks are tested together, and we report them together with their fixes.

[MA-16] Cooperative Transport of Unknown Objects by Distributed Effort Regulation in Multi-agent Systems ICRA2027

【速读】：该论文旨在解决未知形状、尺寸、几何结构、质量及其质量分布的物体在无先验知识（包括物体特性及参与搬运的机器人数量）条件下，由多机器人协同完成运输任务时所面临的挑战。其核心问题在于如何在缺乏精确物体模型的情况下实现稳定、高效且鲁棒的协同推运控制。解决方案的关键在于提出一种无需物体模型的航向误差驱动推力调节方法（object-model-free heading-error-driven pushing effort regulation），通过机器人基于个体与集体航向误差动态调整推力，以促进目标导向的物体运动；同时，当推力点丢失或单个机器人无法通过自身推力纠正航向时，机器人可自主重新定位至物体边界，确保任务连续性。该方法在多种复杂形状（含凸与非凸边界）及动态质量分布场景下验证有效，且表现出对摩擦不均和轮滑等外部扰动的高度鲁棒性，路径效率与运输时间表现稳定，具备良好的可扩展性，运输时间主要取决于物体表面可用推力面数量，而该数量由物体尺寸、形状及机器人间安全距离共同决定。

Abstract:A distributed multi-robot object transportation strategy is proposed for objects of unknown shape, size, geometry, mass and mass distribution without any prior knowledge about the object or number of robots involved in the transportation process. Robots follow the boundary of the object and dynamically determine viable pushing points. A novel object-model-free heading-error-driven pushing effort regulation method is proposed to promote goal-directed object motion; robots regulate their pushing effort using individual and collective heading errors. Robots dynamically relocate around the object boundary if a pushing point is lost or the required pushing effort exceeds its capability to correct its heading. The proposed method is validated using simple and complex shapes with convex and non-convex boundary regions and dynamically changing weight distribution of objects. Detailed analysis on the effects of robot distribution and initial object pose on the transportation performance in terms of required time and path efficiency is also presented. Scalability analysis revealed that object transportation time is dependent on the number of pushing surfaces available which in turn depends on the object size, shape, and set inter-robot safety distance. The proposed system yielded highly efficient object paths with consistent elapsed transport times over several trials robust to external disturbances such as non-uniform friction between contacting surfaces and robot wheel slip.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决动态演变的大气污染物分布实时监测与追踪中，传统方法在复杂风场条件下难以保持高精度、自适应性不足的问题。其核心挑战在于如何实现多无人飞行器（UAVs）在非静态、时变风场下的高效协同感知与轨迹规划，以维持对污染云团的精确时空表征。解决方案的关键在于提出一种自适应密度驱动控制（D²C）框架，通过融合预测性污染物传播模型与动态更新的参考密度分布，引导UAV群的智能路径规划。该框架引入基于传感器的代理烟羽更新机制，利用局部观测的浓度梯度与风场估计，结合梯度吸引、风向平流、样本间排斥及随机扩散等物理过程，实现参考样本的动态演化；同时采用集中式协调结构，各UAV共享局部测量数据至中央协调器，统一维护参考样本集，从而支持系统性的目标分配与轨迹优化。仿真结果表明，在强风和复杂风场条件下，该方法显著优于现有先进基准，在Sinkhorn距离指标上表现更优，尤其在污染云团超出固定监测区域时仍能保持有效追踪，验证了D²C框架在动态环境下的高效性与鲁棒性。

Abstract:Accurate and timely air pollution monitoring and tracking are critical for protecting public health and supporting effective environmental management. This paper presents an adaptive Density-Driven Control (D ^2 C) framework for coordinating multiple unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to track and map dynamically evolving pollutant distributions. The proposed framework extends the D ^2 C strategy to guide UAV trajectories based on predictive pollutant propagation and dynamically updated reference densities. A sensor-driven surrogate plume update mechanism is employed, in which reference samples are propagated using locally sensed concentration gradients and wind estimates through gradient attraction, wind advection, inter-sample repulsion, and stochastic diffusion, enabling UAVs to maintain an accurate spatio-temporal representation of the pollution field. The framework utilizes a coordinated structure where individual UAVs share their local measurements with a central coordinator to maintain a unified set of reference samples, facilitating systematic target allocation and trajectory planning. Simulation results under both mild and strong wind conditions demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in terms of Sinkhorn distance. Specifically, in scenarios where the plume drifts beyond a fixed monitoring domain under high-velocity, time-varying wind fields, the tested baseline methods fail to maintain tracking, whereas the proposed D ^2 C framework successfully adapts to the evolving distribution. These findings highlight D ^2 C as an efficient and resilient solution for atmospheric monitoring in dynamic environments.

[MA-18] Protecting the System Stranding the User: The Limits of Multi-Agent Authorization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前多智能体授权架构过度侧重系统完整性而忽视人类实际影响的问题。现有模型虽能有效防止权限提升，但将失败代价转嫁给人工操作员，导致人机协同效率与用户体验受损。其核心解决方案的关键在于重构授权机制，使其以人类影响为中心：首先，摒弃对用户意图“验证”的伪精确表述，转而采用开放式的概率估计，并根据操作风险动态调整防御强度；其次，指出动态信任评分在跨组织智能体交接中无法维持可信性，因缺乏底层证据传递易违背情境完整性（Contextual Integrity）原则；第三，强调安全中止的工作流不应被视为成功拒绝，若导致用户陷入困境，则补偿措施必须与能力令牌直接绑定，而非仅依赖规划层；最后，提出无摩擦自动化恢复可能引发道德风险，削弱开发者构建稳健初始意图校验的动力。论文最终提出一种融合确定性安全与人类结果的架构整合方案，同时揭示了仍存在的根本理论局限。

机构: University of Southern California(南加州大学); Los Angeles, CA
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Current multi-agent authorization architectures prioritize system integrity over human outcomes. While recent models successfully prevent privilege escalation, they externalize the cost of failure onto the human operator. Re-centering authorization around human impact exposes four structural vulnerabilities in current paradigms. First, calling an agent’s understanding of user intent verified is misleading. Intent has no formal definition, so no check against it can be definitive. Systems should instead report an openly probabilistic estimate and scale their caution with the risk of the action. Second, we argue that dynamic trust scores do not survive multi-agent handoffs; transmitting algorithmic judgment across a company boundary without underlying evidence risks violating Contextual Integrity. Third, treating a safely halted workflow as a successful refusal is a category error if it strands the user; compensating actions must be bound directly to the capability token, not only to the planning layer. Finally, we hypothesize that frictionless automated recovery introduces a moral hazard, disincentivizing developers from building robust initial intent checks. We conclude by proposing an architectural synthesis to bridge the gap between deterministic security and human outcomes, alongside the fundamental theoretical limits that remain unresolved.

[MA-19] Behavioral Assurance for Socially Deployed AI Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前社会部署的AI代理（AI agents）在多样化交互情境中行为一致性不足的问题，即现有评估方法难以确保其行为始终与其预期特征保持一致。其解决方案的关键在于提出一个可量化的评估框架，通过五个可测量的行为维度，结合涵盖六种社会敏感交互场景的标准测试集，系统评估AI代理的行为分化性、一致性及行为漂移情况。该框架引入受控的“角色配置”作为实验锚点，能够有效区分意图性行为差异与仅表现为风格化变异的情况，从而实现对行为意图的真实验证。初步分析表明不同配置间存在可测量的行为差异，并揭示了行为特征与交互结果之间的潜在关联，推动评估范式从单纯的角色设计转向行为保障，为社会应用中AI代理是否持续、可度量地按预期表现提供了科学依据。

Abstract:AI agents are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, yet existing evaluations provide limited assurance that they behave consistently with their intended characteristics across diverse interactions. We introduce an evaluation framework for measuring the behavioral consistency of socially deployed AI agents. The framework operationalizes agent behavior along five measurable axes and uses a standardized evaluation battery spanning six socially salient interaction settings to assess behavioral differentiation, consistency, and drift. Controlled persona configurations serve as experimental anchors, enabling systematic testing of whether intended behavioral differences persist across contexts rather than appearing only as stylistic variation. Preliminary analyses demonstrate measurable differentiation across configurations and suggest associations between behavioral profiles and interaction outcomes. By shifting the focus from persona design to behavioral assurance, this work provides a foundation for evaluating whether socially deployed AI agents behave as intended, consistently and measurably, across the situations in which users encounter them.

[MA-20] LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前大型语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）交易代理在评估其真实交易能力时面临的“技能与运气难以区分”的核心问题。现有基准测试通常依赖单次回测结果来衡量模型表现，但研究表明，同一模型仅因随机种子不同，其回测收益差异可达平均5.2个点，表明单纯依赖收益无法有效区分模型的真实预测能力与偶然性收益。此外，传统回测方法存在严重偏差：要么使用模型训练截止后短暂的市场数据，要么在长时间历史数据上回测，而这些数据可能已被模型记忆；且常将新闻事件与价格按日历日期对齐，导致信息泄露（look-ahead bias）。为克服上述缺陷，本文提出rta-bench-1，一个覆盖美国三个典型市场阶段（牛市、熊市、崩盘）的严格回测框架。该框架确保每条新闻仅在实际发布时间后才被引入，每个交易周期均以盲态和匿名方式处理，并对所有运行进行前瞻性检查以杜绝信息泄露。同时，该框架将收益分解为因子暴露（factor exposure）与超额收益（alpha），并以同日同行业随机选股作为基准，评估每项决策的实际价值。在对六种来自四个供应商的模型进行91次运行的测试中，未发现显著的alpha，市场与风格因子解释了中位数78%的收益，且模型决策表现不优于同行业随机选股。尽管代理倾向于买入正面新闻最多的股票，但在消融实验中，即使移除新闻输入，其收益仍保持不变，说明其行为更多源于规则执行而非新闻驱动。然而，研究发现，若在提示中加入单一现金持有规则，基于GPT的代理在所有六组对比中其持股比例下降30.3个百分点，表明其能可靠执行明确指令。因此，论文的核心解决方案在于：构建基于发布时序的严格回测环境，强调开发者应主动提供可解释的因子暴露与超额收益指标，而评估基准必须按新闻实际发布时间重放数据，以实现对交易代理真实能力的可信评估。

作者: Jackson Wang
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 23 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Code, frozen markets and leaderboard: this https URL . Original empirical study: a backtest benchmark for LLM trading agents and measurements from 91 runs of six models

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) trading agents now trade stocks for their users, and benchmarks rank models by their agents’ returns. Yet a single run’s return says little about skill. In our study, two runs of the same model that differed only in the random seed ended 5.2 points apart on average, so telling skill from luck takes many backtests across markets, models and seeds. However, live arenas trade each day only once, and backtests either use the few months after a model’s training cutoff or run on years the model may remember, often with news joined to prices by calendar date. In this paper, we present rta-bench-1, a backtest over three US markets (a rally, a bear market and a crash). It shows each headline only after its publication minute, plays each period blind and named, and checks every run for look-ahead. It also splits each return into factor exposure and alpha and scores every decision against random choices of the same day and sector. In 91 runs of six models from four vendors, no alpha was significant, market and style exposure accounted for a median 78% of the return, and the decisions did no better than random stocks of the same sector. The agents bought the stocks with the most positive news, yet in ablations they earned as much without their headlines. Still, the agents carried out rules reliably, since a single cash rule in the prompt cut a GPT-based agent’s share in stocks by 30.3 points in all six pairs. Builders should therefore supply the edge themselves and report exposures and alpha, and benchmarks should replay news by publication time.

[MA-21] Delay-Aware Reinforcement Learning for O-RAN Control under Stochastic Reward Feedback

【速读】：该论文旨在解决开放无线接入网（O-RAN）中因反馈异步性导致的动作与奖励之间存在随机延迟，进而引发信用分配错位和训练不稳定的挑战。其核心问题在于传统强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）方法在处理具有未知延迟的观测奖励时，无法有效对齐动作与实际回报，从而影响控制策略的收敛性和可靠性。解决方案的关键是提出一种面向延迟的深度强化学习框架，通过在离策略学习范式中集成基于长短期记忆网络（LSTM）的延迟预测器与时间奖励重对齐模块，实现对延迟的建模与补偿。该框架利用来自Open AI Cellular（OAIC）测试床的真实延迟数据进行验证，结果表明，相较于忽略反馈延迟的传统RL方法，所提方案不仅加速了收敛过程，还显著降低了延迟违规率和包丢失率，充分证明了奖励-延迟补偿机制在实现可靠生成式AI驱动的O-RAN控制中的关键作用。

作者: Xingqi Wu,Junaid Farooq,Tao Li,Juntao Chen,Ying Wang
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly employed for real-time control in Open Radio Access Networks (O-RANs). However, the asynchronous nature of O-RAN feedback introduces stochastic delays between actions and their observable rewards, leading to misaligned credit assignment and unstable training. This letter formulates the O-RAN control problem as a Markov decision process (MDP) with delayed and stochastic rewards, where the true reward corresponding to an action is received after an unknown delay. To address this, we propose a delay-aware deep RL framework that integrates a long short-term memory (LSTM)-based delay predictor and a temporal reward realignment module within an off-policy learning pipeline. Using empirical delay traces collected from the Open AI Cellular (OAIC) testbed, we demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves faster convergence and significantly reduces latency violations and packet drops compared to conventional RL methods that ignore feedback delay. The results confirm that reward-delay compensation is critical for reliable AI-driven O-RAN control.

[MA-22] Macro Control and Capability Evaluation of Black-Box World Models: A Two-Regime Framework for LLM -Agent Markets

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理在多代理市场中难以分离评估“信息模拟”与“宏观涌现”两个关键阶段的问题，传统单一综合评分无法有效区分这两者。其核心解决方案在于提出一种软宏观调控方法（soft macro-control），通过每日公布公开参考路径（reference path）而不干预个体决策、订单或匹配机制，实现对市场行为的引导；同时设计了双模式评估框架，仅基于宏观观测数据即可分别度量两个阶段：在仅参考路径模式下，通过对称真实与反向参考路径共享的水平值 $ R $ 衡量实现程度，其配对差距 $ B $ 反映结构性偏差；在信息注入模式下，外部信息稀释参考路径，仅真实-反向差距 $ \Delta $ 具有可解释性。实验结果表明，在五个单指数LLM代理市场中，发布目标路径显著提升了实际路径对目标的跟踪能力，在无新闻条件下跟踪得分分别提升0.306和0.415，有新闻时提升0.183和0.329；最优结构配置为70%现金/30%股票组合（$ B=0.042 ），技术权重为3:7时实现程度最高（），技术权重为3:7时实现程度最高（），技术权重为3:7时实现程度最高（ R=0.894 $），且引入基本面数据和新闻后 $ \Delta $ 分别为0.0341和0.0487。该方法通过同一组可观测指标在不同可解释性场景下的切换使用，实现了对信息模拟与宏观涌现两阶段的独立、精准评估。

机构: Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China(哈尔滨工业大学深圳); Nanyang Technological University, Singapore(南洋理工大学); Pingan Group, China(平安集团)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents can be organized into multi-agent markets that act as world models, mapping macro information to emergent macro dynamics while the evaluator observes only macro inputs and outputs. This paper separates a model’s capability into two stages that a single aggregate score cannot separate: information simulation, from macro information to micro behavior, and macro emergence, from micro behavior to the macro outcome. We introduce a soft macro-control method that announces a public reference path day by day without touching individual decisions, orders, or matching, and a two-regime evaluation framework that measures both stages from macro observations alone. In the reference-only regime the symmetric true and flipped references share a common level R, which measures realization under the announced reference, while their paired gap B measures structural bias; in the information-injection regime external information dilutes the reference, so only the true-flipped gap Delta remains interpretable. On five single-index LLM-agent markets, announcing a target path shifts the realized path toward the announced target on both announced references under both information conditions. Relative to the no-reference path, the tracking score is higher by 0.306 and 0.415 without news and by 0.183 and 0.329 with news; within the stock/cash scan structural bias is lowest at 70/30 (B=0.042); realization peaks at a 3:7 technical share (R=0.894 versus 0.358 for technical-only); and Delta is 0.0341 with fundamental data and 0.0487 with news. Both stages use the same two observable scores, each read in the regime where it is interpretable.

[MA-23] Staged Semantic Distillation: Preserving Free-Form Semantics in a Low-Compute Non-LLM Surrogate of a Staged LLM Agent

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模基于分阶段大语言模型（LLM）的市场与社会模拟器在实际运行中计算开销过高、推理效率低下且难以部署的问题。具体而言，传统低计算量的蒸馏方法会丢失教师模型生成的非结构化中间状态语义信息，导致学生模型无法有效继承关键决策逻辑。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为“分阶段语义蒸馏”（staged semantic distillation）的新方法：通过冻结编码器将教师模型输出映射为1024维向量，并以带阶段标签的类型化向量形式输入给非LLM学生模型；学生模型在特定阶段可见性约束下接受联合监督，并采用调度自历史（scheduled self-history）进行训练。该方法仅需一次记录的模拟轨迹即可训练出一个1320万参数的确定性学生模型，在单块8GB GPU上训练仅需1658秒，推理时无需调用教师模型或解码器，无文本生成开销（每步决策耗时0.14毫秒），且其分析结果与教师模型保持高度一致（余弦相似度0.943）。实验表明，该学生模型在教师强制回放任务中达到0.8347的平衡准确率，在部署解码器上为0.7783，显著优于无语义重训基线（五种子集增益+2.2 [1.21, 3.14]）。进一步分析揭示，调度自历史机制是性能提升的核心因素，而内容本身在教师强制操作点上才具有决定性作用。研究验证了“应优先投资部署调度设计，让内容在教师强制运行点自然获得其位置”的设计原则，实现了20万次决策的20种子集扫描仅需12分钟，相较教师模型的三小时大幅降低计算成本。

作者: Zhiyang Niu,Huayuan Shen,Chuanjie Li,Mengmeng Zhao,Jiajia Zhang
机构: Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China(哈尔滨工业大学深圳校区); Nanyang Technological University, Singapore(南洋理工大学); Pingan Group, China(平安集团)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Staged LLM agents make market and social simulators realistic, but one 102-day run of a 200-agent, ten-index market simulator issues 203,100 language-model calls and returns one realization. Conventional low-compute distillation drops their free-form intermediate state. We present staged semantic distillation, a low-compute method that preserves non-structured semantics in a non-LLM student trained from one recorded trace. A frozen encoder maps each teacher output to a 1024-d vector; the student sees typed stage-tagged vectors with stage-specific visibility, is jointly supervised, and trains with scheduled self-history. One TwinMarket trace yields a 13.2M-parameter deterministic student that trains in 1,658 seconds on one 8-GB GPU and runs with zero teacher or decoder calls and no text generation (0.14 ms per decision). Its analysis stays close to the teacher (cosine 0.943), and swapping semantic inputs between agents moves 64.7% of decisions against 12.8% for a matched donor, so the channel is preserved and live. We use the surrogate to study what the transfer carries. It reaches 0.8347 balanced accuracy on the teacher-forced replay and 0.7783 [0.766,0.791] on the deployment decoder; the five-seed gain over a no-semantic retrain is +2.2 [1.21,3.14]. Against the teacher’s own re-sampling level, round-one R is 97.1% [95.8,98.4] and 92.3% [89.0,95.4]; R is a diagnostic, not an accuracy. A five-seed content-by-schedule study isolates the gain: scheduled self-history carries it (+2.2 [1.21,3.14]); shuffled and constant content controls reproduce it, while content matters teacher-forced. The design rule: invest in the deployment schedule, let content earn its place at the teacher-forced operating point. A 20-seed, 200,000-decision sweep takes 12 minutes with zero LLM calls, versus three hours for the teacher. The paper is a method-and-case-study contribution on one simulator and trace.

[MA-24] When Reviews Gate Access: Collusion Sabotage and the Scale of Peer Review in the AI Submission Surge

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模机器学习顶会（如NeurIPS、ICLR）在面对投稿量激增背景下，为保障评审质量而引入的复杂评审规则所引发的新型博弈风险问题。这些规则（如作者投稿数量限制、强制互评、基于录用论文获取评审资格、基于评审意愿分配等）虽意在提升公平性与参与度，却无意中使评审者与作者之间形成竞争关系，从而催生了“恶意行为”——包括合谋（collusion）与破坏（sabotage）。其核心解决方案的关键在于：通过构建基于代理（agent-based）的会议模拟系统，结合真实会议统计数据，量化分析上述两类行为在不同规则下的传播机制与影响程度。研究发现，合谋主要改变录用结果，破坏则削弱评分对论文质量的真实反映，二者具有协同放大效应；随机分配机制下，合谋的影响受“盟友暴露指数” $ E = Rm/A $ 限制，但评审意愿投标机制可显著削弱此保护作用；此外，在无投稿量限制的情况下，社交网络中的内层约束（如内部圈层限制）能有效抑制合谋危害，而基于录用获得评审资格的制度若允许破坏行为，则会强化既有评审者的权力优势，进一步拉大新旧评审者之间的差距。因此，该研究揭示了现有评审制度设计中的深层漏洞，并指出制度设计需兼顾激励相容与抗操纵性。

作者: Yuchen Li,Xintong Li,Ken-Tye Yong,Nguyen H. Tran
机构: University of Sydney(悉尼大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI tools have helped push submissions to the largest machine-learning venues to tens of thousands per cycle. Venues have answered with rules that tie access to review: per-author caps, mandatory reciprocal reviewing, reviewer eligibility earned through accepted papers, and assignment based on reviewer bids. Under these rules a reviewer is also a competitor of the authors. We study two deviations that the rules make attractive. Sabotage lowers a competitor’s score. Collusion raises an ally’s score. We build an agent-based conference calibrated to public statistics of NeurIPS and ICLR and run 6,220 simulated conferences. Four results stand out. First, the two deviations do different harm and amplify each other. Collusion changes who is accepted, sabotage erodes what scores say about quality, and rings that may also sabotage gain more than rings that only collude. Second, under random assignment the chance that collusion changes a decision is set by one exposure index, E = Rm/A , the expected number of allies among a paper’s reviewers. Growth therefore protects random assignment, but bidding removes the protection. In a pool of 3,000 reviewers a 20-member ring turns 0.8% of its papers into acceptances under random assignment and 71% when 30% of allies’ bids are granted. Third, when agents choose their allies every cycle, caps at the inner layers of the social brain keep collusion nearly harmless. Without a cap agents ally with half of their area and accepted value falls by 35%. Fourth, reviewer eligibility tied to acceptances turns sabotage into a weapon of incumbents, and a longer eligibility window widens the gap between incumbents and newcomers only when sabotage is possible.

[MA-25] Swarm Shepherd: Securing Multi-Agent Ecosystems Against Persistent Latent Compromise

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式智能体生态系统（Agentic Ecosystems）中潜伏型系统级威胁——“Agentic Sleeper”所带来的安全挑战。此类威胁表现为攻击者在初期以合法行为伪装，逐步获取路由信任，随后在多轮会话、跨智能体及系统层之间累积破坏，最终引发可见性故障，而传统逐轮防御机制难以察觉此类渐进式渗透。其核心问题在于：现有防御手段缺乏对跨会话、跨智能体和跨层级的长期行为关联性监测能力。解决方案的关键在于提出名为Swarm Shepherd的系统级防御框架，该框架基于部分可观测环境下的推理机制，包含两个核心组件：一是通过推断过滤器实现早期预警，二是利用回溯追踪模块进行入侵源头定位。研究进一步提出了一个双尺度部署规则，平衡事件历史长度与智能体覆盖范围，在LangGraph、CrewAI和AutoGen等平台上的实验证明，Agentic Sleeper的漂移速度比自然基线快2.7–8.9倍，且在多数拓扑结构下可跨智能体传播，超过80%的逐轮与状态感知防御均被绕过。Swarm Shepherd可在可见性能退化前至少提前三个会话发出警告（任务评分器评估下为2.6个会话），回溯模块在24种变体上达到0.69的Top-1准确率和0.72的宏平均F1值。双尺度部署规则经实证验证有效，并在真实端到端运行中证明，基于后验引导的防御堆栈能将跨智能体传播抑制至自维持阈值以下，优于仅移除明显受损智能体的传统方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18693
作者: Wuyang Zhang,Shichao Pei
机构: University of Massachusetts Boston(马萨诸塞大学波士顿分校)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
备注: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic ecosystems are emerging as a new platform layer in which agents maintain persistent memory, retrieve from shared knowledge bases, execute through tool interfaces, and coordinate through shared states. These capabilities create a security problem that per-turn defenses miss: compromise can accumulate across sessions, agents, and system layers before visible failure. We define this threat as Agentic Sleeper, a system-level adversary that first behaves legitimately, gains routing trust, and later activates across memory, agent logic, and infrastructure. We formulate defense as inference under partial observability and propose Swarm Shepherd, a system-level defense framework centered on an inference filter for early warning, paired with a backward trace-back module for entry attribution. Our analysis yields a two-scale deployment rule that balances longer event histories against broader agent coverage. Across LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen, Agentic Sleeper drift begins 2.7–8.9 \times faster than natural baselines, propagates across agents on most topologies, and evades per-turn and stateful defenses above 80%. Swarm Shepherd warns at least three sessions before visible degradation (2.6 sessions when failure is scored by the benchmark’s own task grader), while trace-back reaches 0.69 top-1 accuracy and 0.72 macro-F1 over 24 variants. The two-scale deployment rule is empirically confirmed, and in live end-to-end runs on LangGraph and AutoGen the posterior-guided defense stack drives cross-agent propagation below the self-sustaining regime, which removing only the visibly compromised agent does not achieve.

[MA-26] Screen Before You Add: Reducing Candidate Inference in Model Ensembles

【速读】：该论文旨在解决动态集成模型（dynamic ensemble）在新增候选模型时的高效筛选问题，尤其针对推理成本高昂的大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）场景。现有方法依赖全量标注数据集上的完整推断来评估候选模型是否提升集成性能，但这一过程在计算上不可行，且仅依赖基准得分可能产生误导——强单体性能并不保证对集成有正向贡献，甚至优化后的加权策略可能损害测试表现。本文的核心解决方案是基于残差几何结构（residual geometry）实现安全的早期拒绝（early rejection），其关键在于：在凸聚合（convex aggregation）与平方损失或Brier损失下，整体最优解的改进当且仅当候选模型产生的预测变化与现有集成模型在总体样本上的残差呈正向对齐。为此，作者提出一个乐观的二次规划（optimistic quadratic program, QP）以提供可证明的早期拒绝保证；同时引入后验情景采样（posterior-scenario sampling）作为替代启发式方法。实验表明，在两个LLM面板上，采用分层筛选结合认证QP拒绝可节省21–23%的候选模型调用次数，且保持100%的筛选准确率；而结合后验采样进一步将调用节省提升至约37%，仅导致筛选准确率下降不足1个百分点，验证了该方法在效率与精度之间的良好权衡。

作者: Davide Mambelli,Alessandro Rozza,Steven Motta
机构: distributed cognition
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 42 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables, including appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As new models become available, existing ensembles must be updated to be competitive, making them intrinsically dynamic. Deciding whether to add a candidate model can require inference on an entire annotated dataset. Such a screening becomes prohibitive for models with costly inference especially when they ultimately add no value. Even under simple convex aggregation, relying on benchmark scores can be misleading as strong standalone performance does not guarantee ensemble improvement, and fitted ensemble weights can hurt test performance. In this work, we study candidate screening and show how early rejection can be achieved safely, exploiting residual geometry for stratification and rejecting the candidate when the best possible remaining predictions cannot achieve the necessary improvement. The key result that justifies this approach is that, under convex aggregation and squared or Brier loss, the population optimum improves if and only if a candidate induces a prediction change positively aligned with the residuals of the population-optimal existing ensemble. An optimistic quadratic program (QP) provides certified early rejection, while posterior-scenario sampling offers an alternative heuristic. We evaluate the approach by showing the tradeoff between saved calls and screening accuracy, which refers to recovering the same accept/reject result as for the entire annotated dataset. We assess empirically whether full-dataset decisions predict candidate usefulness on a held-out test set. On two LLM panels, stratified screening with certified QP rejection saves 21-23% of candidate calls while keeping 100% screening accuracy. In our experiments, sampling posterior scenarios further increases call savings to approximately 37%, with a loss of less than one percentage point in screening accuracy.

[MA-27] Loop Engineering: Version-Bound Evidence-Gated Coordination for Production Coding Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式AI在实际软件工程生产环境中所面临的系统性挑战，即如何在不依赖私有对话交接的前提下，实现多个异步智能体（agent）循环在共享、可审计的代码仓库状态上安全、可追溯地协同工作。现有编码代理虽能生成代码并执行测试，但无法有效支持生产级软件开发所需的持久任务上下文、作用域授权、版本感知审批、源无关验证、中断恢复以及人机协作中的责任交接等关键需求。其解决方案的核心是提出“环工程”（Loop Engineering）方法，通过定义六要素结构化框架——触发器、上下文投影、权限边界、验证器、终止条件与回写规则——来规范每个智能体循环的行为。在此基础上，采用版本化的程序合约（称为Skills）封装可复用的操作策略，由“集成平台”（Harness）限定动作范围并收集操作证据，同时引入人类审核节点对高影响变更进行基于确切版本的授权。实证研究基于MewDesign商业AI设计产品，部署了五个专业化智能体环（涵盖规划、实施、评审、测试发布与对账），跨26个GitHub工作项的审计显示50条持久标记记录，其中3个拉取请求成功完成受版本约束的测试锁定，并利用独立于请求来源的运行时证据进行验证；另有2个在合并前中止。案例分析揭示了一种“失败闭合”的行为路径：新提交破坏了先前批准与证据链，系统拒绝重用过期的持续集成结果，体现了对状态一致性的严格保障。尽管研究未构成控制性基准实验，亦未证明因果生产力或普适安全性，但提供了在真实生产环境中可行性、可追溯性与有限推进性的初步证据。

作者: Yupeng Pang,Meiling Chen,Yang Yang,Wei Fu
机构: MewDesign
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 16 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Sanitized supporting data included in the source package. Zenodo preprint DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21504929

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Coding agents can edit repositories and execute tests, yet production software work extends far beyond code generation. It requires durable task context, scoped authority, version-aware approval, source-independent verification, interruption recovery, and accountable handoffs between humans and automated workers. We present Loop Engineering, a method for operating multiple asynchronous agent loops over shared, auditable repository state without relying on private conversational handoffs. Each loop is specified by six elements: a trigger, a context projection, an authority boundary, a verifier, a stop condition, and a write-back rule. Versioned procedural contracts, called Skills, encode reusable operating policy; a Harness bounds the available action surface and collects evidence; human gates authorize high-consequence transitions against exact artifact versions. We report a design-and-experience study from MewDesign, a revenue-generating commercial AI design product. Five specialized loops cover planning, scoped implementation, review, test release, and reconciliation. A cross-sectional audit contains 50 durable marker records across 26 GitHub work items. Five pull requests reached a version-bound test lock: three proceeded to test releases with runtime evidence from sources distinct from the deployment request, and two stopped before merge. A detailed drift episode shows one observed fail-closed path: a new commit invalidated prior approval and evidence, and the workflow refused to reuse stale continuous-integration results. The study is not a controlled benchmark and does not establish causal productivity or general safety. It provides early evidence of feasibility, traceability, and bounded progression in one production setting. Comments: 16 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Sanitized supporting data included in the source package. [MA-28] Sivia: Learning to Draw Learning to Learn

【速读】：该论文旨在解决学术论文概述图（overview figure）生成过程中存在的两大核心问题：一是如何准确、高效地从论文内容中提取并表达方法间的逻辑关系，确保科学准确性；二是如何在保持内容一致性的同时，根据用户偏好自适应地优化视觉呈现风格。其解决方案的关键在于提出Sivia系统，该系统通过两阶段递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）机制实现持续优化：第一阶段为“学会画”（learning to draw），基于对生成图像的准确性与美观性反馈，迭代提升绘图能力；第二阶段为“学会学习”（learning to learn），通过优化用于指导修订的更新器（updater），实现对自身改进策略的优化。此外，系统引入个性化用户画像，使视觉风格可适配用户的审美偏好，而科学内容保持不变。实验表明，基于源文本构建的关系规划显著提升了所需关系准确率（RRA），最高达19.85个百分点；在48篇测试论文上，双层级学习使RRA达到93.54%，显著优于初始版本及多个基线模型，同时在可读性和视觉质量方面均有显著提升，且个性化配置显著提高了用户喜爱度与采纳率。

Abstract:A paper’s overview figure is often the first thing readers see: it must explain the method correctly and look polished. We present Sivia, an overview-figure system that reads the paper, plans its relations, adapts visual organization from recent top-conference papers, and composes a design for image generation. Sivia improves with use through human-guided recursive self-improvement (RSI) at two levels: learning to draw revises its drawing skill from feedback on accuracy and presentation, and learning to learn revises the updater that proposes those revisions. A personal profile adapts presentation to its user’s aesthetic preferences while the scientific content stays fixed. A diagnostic study of 1,964 overviews for 445 papers (17,973 relation judgments) shows that most errors are omissions and that source-derived relation plans raise required-relation accuracy (RRA) by up to 19.85 points. On 48 test papers, learning both levels reaches 93.54% RRA, 15.31, 9.38, and 8.33 points above the initial skill, the Fixed-updater, and the GEPA baselines, while readability and visual quality rise from 3.95 and 4.00 to 4.70 and 4.78 on five-point scales. Learned presentation profiles raise liking from 4.02 to 4.73 and adoption from 34 to 45 of 48 tasks. Code and released artifacts are available at this https URL

[MA-29] Borrowed Strength Imported Risk: Capability Gaps and Reception Govern Heterogeneous LLM Debate EACL2027

【速读】：该论文旨在解决异质大语言模型（LLM）辩论中集体推理是否真正带来超越个体能力的性能提升这一核心问题。研究发现，所谓的“集体增益”主要并非源于多样性带来的协同效应，而是由能力传递（capability transfer）驱动：即具备任务优势的模型作为“同行”提供能力，接收方能够吸收其中可量化的部分。其解决方案的关键在于提出并验证了一个经验分解模型 ΔA_d^hon ≈ κΓ_d^+ρ_d，该公式将诚实增益（honest gain）精确描述为同行正向任务优势（Γ_d^+）与接收方接收能力（ρ_d）的乘积，揭示了能力传递的可量化机制。通过九组匹配方向及固定接收方的保留验证，研究证实接收能力在误差范围内保持稳定，而增益随优势增大而线性增长，进一步支持该模型的有效性。此外，在单方向开放式问答探测中，即使接收率高达62.50%，Qwen-7B仍仅实现+1.17点的可控首次交换增益，远低于其与Gemma-3-12B之间的10.78点差距，表明接收能力无法替代正向群体优势。当关键成员被赋予对抗角色时，原本借来的增益消失，甚至导致整体表现低于同质辩论水平。在所有五种全参考设置下，多数正确率始终未超过最具影响力成员的最佳准确率，即便存在未使用的互补回答。因此，异质辩论本质上是一种可测量的能力转移决策过程，具有明确的失效模式，而非单纯由多样性所赋予的优势。

Abstract:Heterogeneous LLM debate is often attributed to collective reasoning that creates capability beyond any member. In the matched panels we study, the aggregate gain is dominated by capability transfer: a peer supplies task competence and receivers absorb a measurable fraction. Across nine matched directions, honest benefit and first-exchange adversarial exposure open when the peer has a positive same-task advantage, and honest gain is closely described by the empirical decomposition \Delta A_d^\mathrmhon\approx\kappa\Gamma_d^+\rho_d , the product of that advantage and the receiver’s reception. Two fixed-receiver directions provide held-out validation without refitting: reception remains stable within uncertainty as a larger peer advantage produces a larger gain. A matched, single-direction open-answer MuSiQue scope probe reaches the negative-gap side of the same gate. Qwen-7B trails the Gemma-3-12B receivers by 10.78 points; despite 62.50% reception, it produces only +1.17 points of controlled first-exchange gain. Reception cannot substitute for positive aggregate peer advantage. When an influential peer is assigned an adversarial role, the same influential peer slot removes the borrowed gain and can push the panel below homogeneous debate. Across all five full-reference settings, the best observed majority correctness does not exceed the influential member’s best observed accuracy, despite unused complementary answers. Heterogeneous debate is therefore a measurable transfer decision with a measurable failure mode, not a benefit conferred by diversity alone.

[MA-30] Brain AI Scientist: An Evidence-Based Multi-Agent System for Translational Neuroimaging in Precision Psychiatry

【速读】：该论文旨在解决精神疾病中基于静息态功能磁共振成像（resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging, rs-fMRI）的脑网络异常发现难以转化为个体化临床决策支持的问题。其核心挑战在于如何将复杂的神经影像数据与临床信息、科学证据有效整合，实现可追溯、可验证的个性化诊疗推理。解决方案的关键在于提出“Brain AI Scientist”这一自主多智能体框架，通过检索、验证与优先级排序机制，融合患者特异性fMRI数据、临床特征及科学文献证据，依托研究领域标准（Research Domain Criteria, RDoC）和循证医学原则，构建从表型到解剖异常、生物标志物、作用机制、干预措施及验证策略的可追踪链路。在自闭症谱系障碍（autism spectrum disorder, ASD）案例中，该框架生成37项解剖学假设，经文献验证保留26项，并从90篇独立文献中提炼出65个有证据支持的生物标志物，最终输出个体化治疗与验证建议。在17例ASD患者中的评估显示，该方法在证据基础性、个性化程度、临床可操作性及生物标志物-治疗推理方面均显著优于GPT-3.5基线模型，无论是否引入fMRI印象。因此，Brain AI Scientist为将患者特异性神经影像转化为精准精神病学中的可审计、可解释的个体化临床决策支持提供了关键技术路径。

Abstract:Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) has revealed widespread brain-network alterations in psychiatric disorders, yet translating these findings into individualized clinical decision support remains challenging. Here we introduce Brain AI Scientist, an autonomous multi-agent framework that integrates patient-specific fMRI, clinical information, and scientific evidence through retrieval, verification, and prioritization. Guided by Research Domain Criteria and evidence-based medicine, it builds traceable chains linking phenotypes, anatomical abnormalities, biomarkers, mechanisms, interventions, and validation strategies. In a representative autism case, Brain AI Scientist generated 37 anatomical hypotheses, retained 26 after literature verification, and derived 65 evidence-supported biomarkers from 90 unique publications to generate patient-specific treatment and validation guidance. Across 17 autism spectrum disorder cases, it outperformed GPT-3.5 baselines with and without fMRI impression in evidence grounding, personalization, clinical actionability, and biomarker-treatment reasoning. Brain AI Scientist therefore provides an auditable framework for translating patient-specific neuroimaging into individualized clinical decision support for precision psychiatry.

[NLP-0] Latent Lattice Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统语言模型在增加计算容量时面临的瓶颈问题，即通过加深网络或引入循环层来提升每标记（per-token）计算量，但受限于残差连接在深层中的信息流动效率。其核心挑战在于如何在不显著增加参数量的前提下，有效扩展模型的计算表达能力。解决方案的关键在于提出“潜空间格栅”（Lattice of Latents），这是一种在每一层中引入横向并行的持续性潜变量流（latent streams），这些潜变量沿时间维度递归运行，与传统的纵向残差流（residual stream）形成互补。不同于以往通过深度方向添加跳跃连接或重路由路径的方式，该框架通过维持跨标记的活跃计算状态，使潜变量直接参与注意力机制、键值缓存写入、MLP计算及解码过程，从而增强模型的动态计算能力。实验表明，在200亿条FineWeb-Edu训练数据上，一个406M参数的带格栅模型将验证困惑度从15.41降至14.40，且在多种架构（如Gated DeltaNet、Mamba-2、Triadic GDN等）中均表现出一致的性能提升，甚至在使用4倍更大原生状态尺寸的基线模型下仍能超越。这表明，持续性的逐层状态是语言模型计算扩展的一个可独立优化的补充维度。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21608
作者: Shivam Duggal,Zongze Wu,William T. Freeman,Antonio Torralba,Richard Zhang,Eli Shechtman
机构: MIT CSAIL(麻省理工学院计算机科学与人工智能实验室); Adobe(Adobe)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. Unlike hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures, whose recurrent states primarily serve as internal memory for sequence mixing, these latents directly condition the vertical stream’s attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. On Transformers trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406M-parameter Lattice model lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 over a parameter-matched Transformer. These gains extend across architectural variants. The Lattice composes with prior residual-stream enhancements: with hyper-connections and input residuals, it lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 (base Transformer) and 14.22 (Transformer with the same enhancements) to 13.61. On Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, Triadic GDN, and GDN-Mamba-2 hybrids, it improves perplexity at every tested native state size, with Lattice-GDN and Lattice-Triadic-GDN variants outperforming pure baselines with 4x larger native states. These results identify persistent per-layer state as a complementary axis for scaling language-model computation.

[NLP-1] Quantifying the added value of human forecaster discussions for tropical cyclone intensity prediction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统数值预测因子在热带气旋强度预报中的局限性，探索人工撰写的技术讨论文本（Tropical Cyclone Discussions）是否能为强度变化预测提供超越数值预报因子的额外价值。其解决方案的关键在于构建一种端到端的深度学习框架，将预报员的定性判断文本与13个来自SHIPS和ERA5再分析数据的环境预测因子进行多模态融合，以提升24至120小时预报时效内的最大持续风速预测精度。研究发现，仅使用讨论文本即可在24小时预报中达到与SHIPS数值因子相当的性能；进一步将文本信息融入基于五种模型的集成系统后，2022–2023年飓风样本的24小时最大持续风速均方误差从9.89节降至8.90节，且置信区间不包含零，表明改进具有统计显著性。此外，文本分析揭示“强度”“强度变化”类关键词（如intensify、weaken、eyewall、category）对模型预测具有关键贡献。尽管再分析数据与实时分析存在差异，且讨论发布时间晚于其他输入数据至少三小时，无法直接用于业务运行，但本研究通过多模态学习验证了专家主观判断在强度预测中的可量化附加值，为融合人类经验与机器学习提供了新范式。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The National Hurricane Center routinely releases Tropical Cyclone Discussions that offer insights into its tropical cyclone forecasts. This study examines the added value of these discussions for intensity forecasting beyond a set of numerical predictors. For 637 Atlantic and eastern North Pacific tropical cyclones from the 2002-2023 hurricane seasons, we analyze the discussion text and its combination with 13 hurricane environmental predictors from SHIPS and ERA5 10-meter wind fields, for forecasting intensity changes at lead times of 24 to 120 hours using three modeling methods. In one approach, an end-to-end deep learning framework for the text shows that the discussions alone offer comparable value for 24-hour intensity forecasts to the SHIPS predictors. Adding discussion information to the SHIPS predictors in an ensemble of five such models reduces the mean absolute error of 24-hour maximum sustained wind forecasts for 2022-2023 cyclones from 9.89 to 8.90 kt, with a confidence interval that excludes zero when whole storms are resampled. The ERA5 wind fields have a minor effect on mean absolute error in wind predictions, and model rankings differ across predicted variables, lead times and model types. We provide prediction intervals for these forecasts, whose coverage falls below the 90% target during rapid intensification. Analysis of the text shows that words related to intensity and intensity change (such as intensify, weaken, eyewall and category) are important for the model predictions. This retrospective study shows the added value of the forecasters’ discussions and suggests that multi-modal learning can help understand the predictive contribution of expert human judgment. The reanalysis data differ from real-time analyses, and the discussions are issued at least three hours after the valid time of the other inputs, so these results should not be interpreted operationally.

[NLP-2] How VLMs Plan Whats Next

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）在描述图像时如何规划生成顺序这一关键问题，即模型在逐个命名图像中的物体时，其决策机制背后的认知过程尚不明确。研究提出了一种可解释的生成规划机制，其核心在于通过四个协同组件实现对视觉-语言交互的分步控制：首先，绑定头（binding heads）将文本提示中的语义信息与图像区域进行匹配，生成指向具体视觉区域的指针；其次，相同绑定头将已生成的回答与其对应的图像区域关联，并将此过程转化为一个“进度信号”——即游标（cursor），指示当前已描述的图像区域边界；第三，选择步骤（select step）基于游标位置，选取最近未被描述的区域，或决定终止生成；最后，注视头（gaze heads）执行所选指针，定位目标区域并提取其语义概念，由语言头和后期多层感知机（MLP）将其转换为符合问题语言的词汇输出。研究通过因果打补丁（causal patching）方法在Qwen3-VL模型上验证了该机制在合成视觉检索任务中的有效性，并排除了多种替代假设。进一步实验表明，该机制在不同输入格式、自然照片及多语言场景下均具鲁棒性，且其绑定、中继与注视头在2B至32B规模的所有模型层级中均稳定出现。本工作不仅揭示了VLM如何逐层、逐词地将问题与图像转化为序列化回答，更为理解大模型在复杂多步任务中进行长程规划提供了可解释的分析框架。

作者: Rohit Gandikota,Arnab Sen Sharma,Adam Belfki,David Bau
机构: Northeastern University (东北大学)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at this https URL

[NLP-3] Beyond Job Titles: Interpreting Early-Career Job Advertisements with Sparse Autoencoders and Semantic Clustering

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在快速变化的就业市场中，仅依靠职位名称和职位描述难以准确揭示技术类岗位之间实际工作内容与行业应用差异的问题。其核心挑战在于如何从海量非结构化文本数据中提取具有语义意义的岗位特征模式，并实现对不同技术角色的系统性比较。解决方案的关键在于提出并应用一种结合深度学习与变压器（Transformer）表示的综合分析框架——PERC（Preprocessing, Embedding, Dimensionality Reduction, and Clustering），并通过多阶段自动化流程实现对职位描述的细粒度解析与聚类。具体而言，研究利用GPT-6 Luna对职位描述进行三段式分类（团队背景、职责任务、资格要求），生成语义组合后进行嵌入表示与聚类分析；采用最大均值差异（MMD）量化不同岗位间嵌入分布的差异性，并借助预训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）从Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型第19层的激活表示中提取高阶特征；最后通过GPT-6.1 Terra验证所发现特征模式在未见企业数据中的泛化能力。该方法不仅实现了对数据科学家、数据分析师与机器学习工程师等岗位在技术侧重上的精准区分（如模型开发、业务报告、真实场景部署等），还为自动化洞察提取提供了可扩展的技术路径，显著提升了人工分析效率与客观性。

作者: Yisong Cao,Leah Kim,Brian Wright,Ali Rivera
机构: Active Learning Lab; School of Data Science, University of Virginia (弗吉尼亚大学数据科学学院)
