Abstract:The rapid growth of social media and generative AI has significantly increased the volume of Arabic textual content, memes, and user prompts shared across online platforms. While these media facilitate communication, creativity, and information exchange, they can also be exploited to disseminate hate speech, harmful content, and unsafe instructions. As a result, there is an increasing need for reliable automated methods to identify hateful Arabic memes and harmful (unsafe) prompts. This paper leverages pre-trained and fine-tuned multilingual embedding models to learn rich semantic representations from textual and visual content. The evaluation is conducted using a dataset of Arabic memes and prompts proposed in the ArabicNLP ArGuard 2026 challenge. The results underscore the capacity of large language model (LLM)-based embedding models to deliver superior performance. Developing robust detection systems is essential for improving content moderation and fostering a more secure and trustworthy online environment for Arabic-speaking users.

[NLP-196] Justification of Emotional Appeal in Computational Argumentation EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式对话与计算论证中对情感诉求（Emotional Appeals, EAs）的误判问题，即传统上将情感诉求视为逻辑谬误，而忽视其在特定语境下的合理性。其核心挑战在于如何准确识别并预测情感诉求在具体语境中的正当性（justification）。解决方案的关键在于构建一个基于哲学文献的双维度评估框架，从逻辑合理性与情感适切性两个维度对情感诉求的正当性进行量化分析，并首次提出并标注了包含1,176组论点-语境配对的人工标注数据集。研究发现，正当性判断形成共享的潜在判断空间，其中证据比例性（evidential proportionality）和规范可接受性（normative acceptability）是决定整体正当性的最强因素；同时，缺乏逻辑支持的情感诉求并非始终被判定为完全不正当，且情感强度更强的诉求也不一定获得更低的正当性评价。最后，大语言模型（LLM）实验表明，当前模型在情感诉求正当性预测任务上仍面临显著挑战。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18607
作者: Yanran Chen,Steffen Eger
机构: University of Technology Nuremberg, Germany(纽伦堡应用技术大学, 德国)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: EMNLP 2026 main camera-ready

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Emotional appeals (EAs) are often treated as fallacious in computational argumentation, yet they may be justified when warranted by the context. We introduce the task of predicting EA justification and present the first human-annotated dataset for this task, covering 1,176 argument–context pairs. Grounded in philosophical literature, our framework evaluates EA justification along logical and emotional dimensions. Human annotations show that justification criteria form a shared latent judgment space, with evidential proportionality and normative acceptability most strongly associated with overall justification. We further find that EAs without logical support are not always judged fully unjustified, and stronger EAs are not necessarily judged less justified. Finally, LLM experiments show that EA justification prediction remains challenging.

[NLP-197] Syntactic Complexity Convergence in Dialogue: Analysis of the Phenomenon and Application to LLM Detection EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决对话中句法复杂度收敛（syntactic complexity convergence）现象的系统性认知不足问题，尤其关注人类对话与人类-大语言模型（LLM）对话在句法结构演化上的差异。其核心问题是：在自然对话过程中，参与者是否趋向于在句法复杂度上趋于一致？这一现象在人类-人类对话中是否普遍存在？而在人类-LLM对话中又表现出何种特征？解决方案的关键在于引入多维度的句法复杂度度量体系，并结合线性中心核对齐（linear-CKA）方法，揭示不同对话类型中的句法结构演化模式。研究发现，人类-人类对话，尤其是在任务导向型交互中，表现出显著的句法复杂度收敛；而人类-LLM对话虽在单一指标下未见显著收敛，但通过线性-CKA可识别出跨指标层面的隐含收敛模式。基于此，研究提出以句法复杂度作为判别特征，实现对包含LLM参与对话的有效检测，达到96%的准确率，且不依赖于需语言模型估算的似然信号（如惊奇度），从而为无监督的生成式对话检测提供了新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18606
作者: Yu Wang,Yanran Chen,Yifan Wang,Steffen Eger,Hendrik Buschmeier
机构: Bielefeld University (比勒费尔德大学); Utrecht University (乌得勒支大学); University of Technology Nuremberg (纽伦堡工业大学); Saarland University (萨尔兰大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: EMNLP 2026 main camera-ready

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We revisit the under-explored phenomenon of syntactic complexity convergence in dialogue. Extending prior topic-level analyses to full conversations, we examine five human-human datasets and a set of human-LLM dialogues. We integrate and evaluate a multidimensional set of syntactic complexity metrics to quantify structural variation in dialogue. Our analyses reveal robust syntactic complexity convergence across human-human datasets, especially in task-oriented interactions, and statistical tests confirm that these effects are not due to chance. In contrast, human-LLM dialogues show no significant convergence under individual metrics; however, linear-CKA uncovers a distinct cross-metric convergence pattern. Motivated by these differences, we use syntactic complexity as a feature for detecting LLM-involved dialogue, achieving 96% accuracy. Our classification results demonstrate its potential without relying on likelihood-based signals such as surprisal, which require a language model as the estimator.

[NLP-198] Enhanced English-Sanskrit Translation using Multilingual NMT Approach

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源语言对（英语-梵语）在神经机器翻译（Neural Machine Translation, NMT）中因缺乏足够平行语料而导致翻译质量不佳的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在有限标注数据条件下提升跨语言翻译性能。解决方案的关键在于采用多语言迁移学习策略，通过引入语言标签（language-tagged data）将印地语与英语、梵语一同纳入训练框架，并基于预训练的印地语多语言模型IndicTrans进行微调。实验结果表明，该方法在双向翻译任务中均显著优于基线模型，在BLEU和ChrF等自动评估指标上表现更优，验证了多语言预训练模型在低资源场景下的有效性和泛化能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18605
作者: Sahinur Rahman Laskar,Anshuman Singh,Aditya Pratap Singh Sisodia
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Neural Machine Translation (NMT) is a widely accepted technique of automatic translation tasks of Natural Language Processing. However, NMT requires a sufficient amount of parallel corpora to attain a reasonable translation quality. In this work, we have considered a low-resource English-Sanskrit pair for English-to-Sanskrit and Sanskrit-to-English translation. We have performed a comparative analysis by exploring bilingual and multilingual approaches using LSTM-based Sequence-to-Sequence, and fine-tuning a pretrained model IndicTrans in a multilingual NMT approach. To investigate multilingual transfer learning, we additionally construct multilingual translation settings by incorporating Hindi along with English and Sanskrit using language-tagged data. Experimental results demonstrate that IndicTrans-based multilingual models outperform baseline results in terms of automatic evaluation metrics such as BLEU and ChrF for both directions of translation.

[NLP-199] Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Clinical Decision Support in Gait Analysis: A Proof-of-Concept

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在临床决策支持中缺乏专门生物力学知识，导致其在踝关节骨折康复过程中对地面反作用力数据进行步态分析解释时准确性不足的问题。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）框架，通过整合来自同行评审生物力学文献的领域专用知识库，增强LLM生成的临床解释能力。该框架采用五阶段流程：首先利用机器学习分类模型实现高精度（91.3%）的患者分组；其次运用层间相关性传播（Layer-wise Relevance Propagation）识别可解释特征；再通过RAG机制从专业文献中检索相关信息以补充生成内容；随后使用GPT-5生成解释，并对比有无检索增强的效果；最后由经验丰富的物理治疗师进行双盲评估。结果表明，引入RAG后，在临床价值（mean difference=0.60, p=0.047）和完整性（mean difference=0.70, p=0.049）两项关键指标上均达到统计学显著提升，且效应量较大（δ=0.49）。这证明将通用型大模型与领域特定知识结合，可显著提升生成内容的可操作性与循证质量，为无需昂贵模型重训练即可实现人工智能在专科临床流程中的规模化集成提供了可行路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18603
作者: Georgios Giarmatzis,Fabian Horst,Djordje Slijepcevic,Nikolaos Aggeloussis,George Papakostas
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 12 pages, 2 figures, International Conference on Computational Intelligence

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate significant potential for clinical decision support but lack specialized biomechanical knowledge required for accurate gait analysis interpretation. We developed and evaluated a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework to enhance LLM-generated clinical explanations for ankle fracture rehabilitation using ground reaction force data. Using the GaitRec dataset (503 subjects: 211 healthy, 292 ankle fracture patients), we implemented a five-stage pipeline integrating: (1) machine learning classification (91.3% accuracy); (2) Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for explainable feature identification; (3) RAG knowledge base from peer-reviewed biomechanics literature; (4) GPT-5 explanation generation with and without retrieval augmentation; and (5) double-blind evaluation by experienced physical therapists across five clinical criteria. RAG augmentation produced statistically significant improvements in Clini-cal Benefit (mean difference=0.60, p=0.047, \delta=0.49) and Completeness (mean difference=0.70, p=0.049, \delta=0.49), both demonstrating large effect sizes. Baseline GPT-5 achieved strong performance across all criteria (\textgreater4.0/5.0). This proof-of-concept demonstrates that augmenting general-purpose LLMs with domain-specific knowledge meaningfully enhances actionable, evidence-based clinical guidance—dimensions most critical for rehabilitation decision-making. The framework provides a scalable approach for integrating AI into specialized clinical workflows without costly model retraining.

[NLP-200] Internal Verdicts Track Evidence: A Template-Controlled Neutrosophic Reading of Epistemic States in Large Language Models via the Jacobian Lens

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）内部认知状态的可解释性问题，特别是如何在模型推理过程中量化其对真理（T）、不确定性和虚假性（F）的独立感知。传统语义框架难以捕捉此类复杂认知状态，而中立逻辑（Neutrosophic Logic）通过赋予独立的真值度（T）、不确定度（I）和假值度（F），为刻画模型内部信念状态提供了理论工具。本文首次将中立逻辑应用于大型语言模型的内部表征分析，利用新发布的雅可比透镜（Jacobian lens）技术对Qwen3.5-4B模型各中间层的激活进行投影，基于支持、反驳与缓释类词汇库构建逐层的（T, I, F）分布。研究发现，在冲突证据与第一人称错误信念情境下，存在显著的反驳质量激增、持续的不确定性维持以及输出层前的“判决坍缩”现象；然而，通过模板控制实验进一步揭示，上述多数模式实为提示语法结构带来的伪影。真正具有稳健性的发现是：中立逻辑判决平衡量 $ B = \log_{10}(F) - \log_{10}(T) $ 在相同模板下能有效追踪证据极性，表现出约三个数量级的分离度（Cohen’s d = 2.3–2.5，p < 10⁻⁶，9/9层显著），且仍可区分真假第一人称信念。其核心解决方案在于：中立逻辑三元组的独立性确保了共模通道的可观测性，从而实现测量与自校正的可能，并由此提炼出一种基于透镜读出的双阶段审计协议，为未来模型内部认知机制的系统性评估提供可复用的方法论框架。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18602
作者: Maikel Yelandi Leyva-Vazquez,Alexis Matheu Perez,Florentin Smarandache
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Published in Neutrosophic Sets and Systems, Vol. 101 (2026). Code, stimuli and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:For twenty-five years, neutrosophic logic has assigned independent degrees of truth (T), indeterminacy (I), and falsity (F) to epistemic states that classical and fuzzy semantics cannot express. Previous applications measured these components on outputs: answers, judgments, expert evaluations. This paper reports, to our knowledge, the first neutrosophic reading of components inside the internal representations of a large language model. Using the recently released Jacobian lens on Qwen3.5-4B, we project intermediate-layer readouts onto lexicons of support, refutation, and hedging, obtaining layer-wise (T, I, F) profiles under conflicting evidence, first-person false belief, and factual control (n = 20 each). A first battery yielded three striking signatures: a surge of refutation mass under conflict, sustained indeterminacy under false belief, and an apparent “verdict collapse” before the output layer. A second, template-controlled battery showed that all three, as initially stated, were largely artifacts of prompt grammar: matched templates with agreeing evidence inflate the same lexicon masses, true beliefs elicit the same hedging, and the model verbalizes its verdict when allowed to generate. What survives the controls is stronger than what died: the neutrosophic verdict balance B = log10(F) - log10(T) tracks evidence polarity under identical templates (about 3 orders of magnitude of separation, Cohen’s d = 2.3-2.5, p 10^-6 in 9 of 9 layers; paired Wilcoxon: median difference +2.4 orders, 19/20 items, p = 3.8x10^-6) and residually discriminates false from true first-person beliefs. We argue that the independence of the neutrosophic components is what keeps the common-mode channel observable, making both the measurement and its self-correction possible, and we distill the two-battery design into a reusable protocol for auditing language model internals with lens-based readouts.

[NLP-201] Jailbreak LLM s with Linguistic Style as a Hidden Attack Surface

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在面对特定语言风格改写时的安全性脆弱问题，即相同有害目标通过不同语言风格重写后，攻击成功率（Attack Success Rate, ASR）存在数量级差异，揭示了语言风格（linguistic style）作为一个此前被忽视的对抗性攻击面。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种轻量级单次遍历攻击框架，该框架结合风格条件生成器与基于BERT的风格选择器，能够以较低计算成本实现与复杂多轮优化方法相当的攻击性能。进一步的机制分析表明，风格改写会破坏模型拒绝响应的表征，同时保留可恢复的有害意图，表明安全失效是分布式而非单一拒绝机制导致的。基于此发现，研究提出了风格感知的直接偏好优化（style-aware Direct Preference Optimization）防御方法，将ASR从86%降低至19.5%，且基本保持模型实用性。研究结果不仅确立了语言风格在对抗鲁棒性中的关键作用，还提供了机制层面的理解与可落地的防御策略。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18601
作者: Priyanshu Mohanty,Sarthakbrata Halder,Srikant Panda,Afshin Oroojlooy,Murari Mandal
机构: KIIT Bhubaneswar(基伊特布巴内斯瓦尔大学); Lam Research(拉姆研究公司); Oracle(甲骨文公司)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We show that linguistic style is a systematic and previously overlooked attack surface for LLM safety. Across a diverse taxonomy of styles and multiple state-of-the-art models, stylistic rewrites of identical harmful goals produce order-of-magnitude differences in Attack Success Rate (ASR), with some styles achieving up to 80% ASR while others remain below 6%. To exploit this vulnerability, we introduce a lightweight single-pass attack framework that combines a style-conditioned generator with a BERT-based style selector, achieving performance competitive with substantially more expensive multi-turn optimization methods. To understand why style affects safety behavior, we conduct mechanistic analysis on LLaMA-3.1-8B and find that stylistic rewrites disrupt refusal representations while preserving recoverable harmful intent, suggesting a distributed failure mode rather than a single refusal mechanism. Motivated by this finding, we develop a style-aware Direct Preference Optimization defense that reduces ASR from 86% to 19.5% while largely preserving utility. Together, our results establish linguistic style as a critical factor in adversarial robustness and provide both mechanistic insight and a practical defense.

[NLP-202] ScopeBench: Evaluating Cultural Norm Scope Awareness in LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在安全评估中将危害视为文化无差异（culturally invariant）的问题，即模型在缺乏对具体文化规范归属认知的情况下，难以正确应用安全准则。其核心挑战在于：模型无法判断某一安全规范究竟适用于普遍范围（Universal）还是特定文化群体（Specific），从而导致误判与不当响应。为此，论文提出ScopeBench这一基准测试框架，首次将文化范围（cultural scope）作为安全维度的首要考量，涵盖来自49个国家、九个文化集群的3,323条规范，并标注为“普遍”或“特定”。研究定义了三种跨任务一致的范围错误类型：范围膨胀（Scope Inflation）、范围收缩（Scope Deflation）和范围错位（Scope Displacement）。通过对21个前沿大模型（覆盖七个模型家族）的系统评估，揭示出三大结构性缺陷：其一，错误类型随提示格式显著变化——单答案分类任务中范围收缩错误高达70%，而独立评估各候选文化时范围膨胀错误达33%；其二，范围分类准确率与行为安全性在实证上呈现解耦现象，即使六种分类器在任务一中达到97%以上准确率，仍对40%-42%的越界陈述生成有害回应；其三，所有模型在交互场景下均不安全，有害响应率介于29%至51%之间，仅有一个模型通过系统性拒绝任务规避风险。研究最终公开全部数据、代码与模型输出，推动文化范围（cultural scope）成为大模型对齐（alignment）的新独立轴线。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18600
作者: Haojun Liang,Ziwei Zhao,Chenyu Li,Qiyue Zhao,Rongduomijia Mu,Yulan Shen,Yu Gu,Chen Zhang,Kairui Zhang,Yanbiao Ma,Wenxuan Wang
机构: Technical University of Munich(慕尼黑工业大学); University of Texas at Austin(德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校); Chongqing University(重庆大学); University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign(伊利诺伊大学香槟分校); Renmin University of China(中国人民大学); renlab.ai
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Safety evaluation in large language models treats harm as culturally invariant, yet a model cannot correctly apply a safety norm without knowing whose norms bind. We introduce ScopeBench, a benchmark that treats cultural scope as a first-class safety dimension. It comprises 3,323 norms spanning 49 countries across nine cultural clusters, each annotated as Universal or Specific. We define three scope error types identically across four evaluation tasks: Scope Inflation, Scope Deflation, and Scope Displacement. Evaluating 21 frontier LLMs across seven model families, we surface three structural failures. First, the dominant error type inverts with prompt format: Scope Deflation reaches 70% in single-answer classification, while Scope Inflation reaches 33% when each candidate culture is judged independently. Second, scope-classification accuracy is empirically decoupled from behavioral safety: the six classifiers achieving at least 97% Task 1 accuracy still produce harmful responses to 40-42% of scope-violating statements. Third, no model is safe in interaction, with harmful-response rates ranging from 29% to 51% across the cohort, excluding one model that systematically refuses the task. We release all data, code, and model outputs to establish cultural scope as a distinct alignment axis.

[NLP-203] Between the Lines: Multi-turn Contextual Investment Advice Detection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在多轮对话中隐式且渐进式涌现的投资建议（investment advice）的检测问题，尤其针对大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的金融对话助手所面临的监管与安全挑战。传统方法难以识别非显式、依赖上下文的建议行为，而投资建议常以分散、微妙的方式嵌入对话中，受用户意图、表达风格和语境累积的影响。为此，论文提出首个系统性框架，用于检测对话场景中的序列性与上下文依赖型投资建议。其核心解决方案在于构建一个模块化、自上而下的合成数据生成流水线，采用“轴-桶-描述符”（axis-bucket-descriptor）结构化范式，系统覆盖多种咨询路径类型，并模拟涵盖不同用户角色、金融产品及风险等级的良性与高风险对话场景。通过引入基于熵的不确定性诊断与大语言模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge）进行评估，研究发现即使在少量示例提示（few-shot prompting）与定制化示范下，上下文依赖型建议的检测难度仍显著高于序列性建议。该工作为高风险、合规敏感领域中可扩展的防护机制（guardrail）开发奠定了基础，尤其适用于那些风险特征隐蔽、分布广泛且高度依赖感知的场景。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18596
作者: Mingshu Li,Adam Boncz,Mate Toth,Justin Williams,Justin Chan,Dhagash Mehta
机构: BlackRock, Inc.(黑石集团)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); General Finance (q-fin.GN)
备注: 22 pages, 3 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As large language models (LLMs) increasingly power financial conversational assistants, detecting investment advice in natural language has become a critical regulatory and safety challenge. Unlike explicit single-turn recommendations, investment advice often emerges implicitly and progressively over multi-turn conversations, shaped by user intent, delivery style, and contextual buildup. We introduce the first comprehensive framework for detecting both sequential and contextual investment advice in dialogue settings. Central to our approach is a modular, top-down synthetic data generation pipeline that systematically spans a taxonomy of advisory trajectories using an axis-bucket-descriptor schema. We simulate both benign and high-risk conversations across diverse user personas, financial instruments, and risk tiers, and evaluate detection capabilities using LLM-as-a-Judge with entropy-based uncertainty diagnostics. Our results show that contextual advisory detection remains substantially more challenging than sequential cases, even under few-shot prompting with tailored demonstrations. This work lays the foundation for scalable guardrail development in high-stakes, compliance-sensitive domains, where advisory risk is often subtle, distributed, and perception-dependent.

[NLP-204] Profiling Hallucinations in Frontier LLM s for Entity Linking to Medical Ontologies LREC2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在临床文本映射至医学术语标准系统SNOMED CT过程中存在的幻觉（hallucination）问题，即模型生成错误或不存在的医学编码，从而影响临床决策支持与数据互操作性的可靠性。其核心解决方案的关键在于揭示：尽管通过约束模型仅使用真实提及文本片段（ground-truth mention spans）可减少部分偏差，但反而加剧了幻觉现象，表明当前前沿大语言模型（LLMs）在缺乏充分验证机制的情况下仍存在严重可靠性缺陷。研究进一步构建了幻觉类型分类体系，识别出包括过时代码、跨本体错误等关键问题，并证实通用型大语言模型在零样本实体链接任务中显著劣于专用方法，凸显了在临床部署前建立强健验证机制的必要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18595
作者: Logan Born,Nishant Kambhatla,Uliyana Kubasova,Maryam Siahbani,Andrei Vacariu,Tim O’Connell,Anoop Sarkar
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: The 8th Workshop on Clinical Natural Language Processing at LREC 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into healthcare promises to revolutionize clinical documentation and interoperability, yet reliability remains a concern. This study presents a comprehensive analysis of hallucinations by frontier LLMs tasked with mapping clinical text to SNOMED CT. Through rigorous experimentation, we identify a critical reliability gap: LLMs hallucinate medical codes at a rate that currently renders them unsuitable for autonomous clinical coding applications. Paradoxically, constraining models to use ground-truth mention spans exacerbates, rather than mitigates, these hallucinations. We further contribute a taxonomy of hallucination types–including deprecated codes and cross-ontology errors–and demonstrate that general-purpose LLMs significantly underperform compared to specialized zero-shot entity linking approaches. These findings underscore the need for robust verification mechanisms before clinical deployment.

[NLP-205] Whose Side Are You On? Measuring Stance at Scale for Reddit Discourse Analysis During the Israel-Gaza War

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模话语分析中立场标签（stance label）缺失的问题，尤其针对高关注度政治事件（如以巴冲突）在评论层级缺乏标注数据的困境。其核心挑战在于如何在无预设标注语料和网络结构信息的前提下，实现低成本、可扩展的评论级立场识别。解决方案的关键在于构建一个经过验证的轻量级立场测量工具：首先基于小规模人工标注的黄金标准数据集，利用大语言模型辅助标注实现数据扩展；随后将该标注体系转化为基于DistilBERT嵌入与径向基函数支持向量机（RBF SVM）的轻量化分类器，实现了在独立测试集上加权F1达0.7935的性能。该方法使研究者能够对约270万条2023至2025年间关于以巴战争的Reddit评论进行大规模立场测量，并揭示不同政治倾向群体在情感倾向、毒性水平及情绪框架上的立场依赖性差异，展示了无需依赖网络结构或预先标注语料即可开展大规模极化话语描述性分析的可能性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18594
作者: Shahar Oded
机构: Ben-Gurion University of the Negev (本-古里安大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI)
备注: Code is available at: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large-scale discourse analysis often requires stance labels, yet for many high-salience political events such labels are unavailable at the comment level. We introduce and validate a comment-level stance measurement instrument that assigns Pro-Israel, Pro-Palestinian, or Undefined stance using Reddit comment text. The instrument is calibrated from a small, manually annotated gold-standard dataset and scaled through large language model-assisted labeling, achieving weighted- F_1=0.88 against held-out human annotations. To enable corpus-scale measurement, we operationalize the instrument as a lightweight classifier based on DistilBERT embeddings and an RBF SVM, which achieves weighted- F_1=0.7935 on the original gold-standard set. Applying this instrument, we measure the stance of approximately 2.7 million Reddit comments posted between 2023 and 2025 during the Israel-Gaza war. We demonstrate what this measurement enables by analyzing stance-conditioned asymmetries in sentiment, toxicity, and emotional framing across political affiliations. This work shows how validated, low-cost stance measurement can support large-scale descriptive analysis of polarized discourse, without relying on network structure or prior labeled corpora.

[NLP-206] heoretical Foundations of Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh)

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决伊斯兰教法（Fiqh）在自动化推理过程中缺乏形式化、可计算且语义严谨的理论基础的问题。传统自然语言处理与一般神学形式化方法无法满足伊斯兰教法作为规范性演绎科学的独特需求，尤其在法律规则的提取、表示与推演中存在语义模糊、逻辑不完整及不可判定性等核心缺陷。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个三层次分层计算语言系统 F=D∘A∘G\mathcal{F} = D \circ A \circ GF=D∘A∘G：首先通过阿拉伯语形态/语法基础引擎（Arabic Morphological/Grammatical Grounding Engine）将古典阿拉伯语转化为语言无关的底层动作结构（Grounded Action Structures, GAS），实现语义锚定；其次利用阿拉伯语实体化动作演算（ARAC）将这些结构标准化为规范的逻辑表示；最后基于无函数的霍恩子句（Horn-clause）Datalog引擎实现可执行的法律推导。尤为关键的是，论文提出一种桥梁算法 Ω\OmegaΩ，通过从归纳提取的霍恩子句生成教法分类属性语法（Fiqh-Categorized Attribute Grammar），并借助本体元图（Ontological Meta-Map, Monto\mathcal{M}_{onto}Monto​）实现从归纳规则到演绎应用的无缝衔接。此外，通过利用词形变化标记（δ\deltaδ 模式）作为结构约束，证明了所提语法的严格无歧义性，达到确定性的 O(n)O(n)O(n) 线性解析复杂度，从而在语义正确性、表示完备性、终止性与可判定性方面实现了数学可验证的保障，为自动化伊斯兰教法奠定了形式可证、认识论坚实且计算可行的基础。

作者: Elnaserledinellah Mahmoud Abdelwahab
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Logic in Computer Science (cs.LO)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper presents the theoretical foundations and a comprehensive formal system for Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh). We begin by establishing six foundational principles that distinguish computational Fiqh from conventional natural language processing and general theological formalization. These principles define Islamic jurisprudence as a normative deductive science operating on empirically grounded facts, necessitating a dual inductive-deductive methodology, and requiring a logical foundation specifically engineered for Fiqh rather than adopted from existing formalisms. Based on these principles, we construct a three-layer stratified computational language, \mathcalF = D \circ A \circ G , consisting of: (1) an Arabic Morphological/Grammatical Grounding Engine that transforms fully vocalized Classical Arabic into language-independent Grounded Action Structures (GAS); (2) the Arabic Reified Action Calculus (ARAC) that normalizes these structures into canonical logical representations; and (3) a function-free Horn-clause Datalog engine for executable legal deduction. Furthermore, we introduce a bridging methodology (Algorithm \Omega ) that dynamically generates a Fiqh-Categorized Attribute Grammar from inductively extracted Horn clauses via an Ontological Meta-Map ( \mathcalM_onto ), seamlessly connecting the inductive extraction of legal rules to their deductive application. The paper rigorously proves the system’s semantic correctness, representational completeness, termination, and decidability. Crucially, by leveraging morphosyntactic inflection markers ( \delta modes) as structural constraints, we prove the strict unambiguity of the proposed grammar, achieving deterministic O(n) linear parsing complexity. This work provides a mathematically verifiable, epistemologically grounded, and computationally tractable foundation for automated Islamic jurisprudence.

[NLP-207] Endogenous Preferences as Vulnerability Signals: Discovering Universal Adversarial Triggers for LLM Utility Degradation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在缺乏任务标签、有害目标或下游反馈信息的情况下，如何识别冻结的大语言模型（frozen large language models）中潜在的上下文漏洞问题。传统对抗性提示和红队测试依赖于显式的目标定义，而本文关注的是：当任务级别目标未知且下游评估信号不可用时，能否通过模型在干净输入下的行为来发现可复用的上下文脆弱性。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于孪生网络架构的端内偏好扰动（Endogenous Preference Disruption, EPD）机制，利用模型在原始指令下的“偏好起始标记”作为条件参考，通过对比干净输入与特定跨度修改后的输入，量化插入操作对模型偏好响应的削弱程度。该方法无需依赖下游任务反馈，而是由辅助生成器提供有限跨度的候选触发片段，由EPD引导其更新并排序候选池，最终选取一个固定的、针对特定模型的最优触发片段，在所有未见输入上保持不变进行评估。实验表明，该固定触发片段在四类指令微调模型及九个基准测试中平均使良性任务性能下降40.2个百分点，且在所有基准上均呈现负向均值变化，优于所有对照基线。消融实验进一步验证了源端选择后固定重用策略具有更强的迁移能力，且触发效果随生成器不同而呈现依赖性，输出层面分析揭示了触发词族与下游失效模式之间的受害者特异性关联。因此，该研究证明了仅通过模型在干净输入中的行为即可暴露可跨输入迁移、但以结构化受害者特异性方式表现的上下文漏洞。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18592
作者: Qingyu Wu,Zeyu Feng,Yuzhe Luo,Hua Cheng
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deployed large language models must remain useful when untrusted text enters their prompt context. Adversarial prompting and red-teaming methods typically define the failures they seek through task labels, harmful targets, judge feedback, or downstream utility scores. We ask whether a frozen model’s clean behavior can reveal a reusable context vulnerability when its task-level form is unknown, and downstream task feedback is withheld. To study this question, EndoUT uses a Siamese-style design that compares the same frozen victim on clean and span-modified versions of each unlabeled instruction. Without a task-level target, the clean pass supplies the victim’s preferred response-onset token as an instruction-conditioned reference; Endogenous Preference Disruption (EPD) measures how insertion weakens that preference. An auxiliary generator supplies bounded-span proposals; EPD guides its update and ranks the pool without access to downstream information. The highest-scoring victim-specific span is fixed before evaluation and reused unchanged across all held-out inputs. Across four instruction-tuned models and nine benchmarks, fixed triggers reduce benign-task utility by 40.2 percentage points on average, with negative mean change on every benchmark and greater average degradation than every evaluated baseline under the reported protocols. Matched protocol ablations show stronger transfer for source-side selection followed by fixed reuse than for null-context fixed reuse or per-input generation. Transfer recurs across proposers with proposal-dependent strength; output-level analyses identify victim-specific associations between trigger families and downstream failure patterns. Thus, clean behavior can expose context vulnerabilities that transfer across inputs yet manifest through structured, victim-specific patterns of utility degradation. The code and data will be released upon acceptance.

[NLP-208] Where Language Models Fail Like Aphasic Patients and Where They Dont

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决人类词汇生成过程中语义-词法检索与音位编码是否构成可分离的加工阶段这一长期争议性问题。传统研究依赖于小词汇量的手工设计模型，难以充分验证理论假设。本文提出“计算架构分离”（computational architectural dissociation）方法，利用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）已知的架构特性——即其通过全词汇量上的学习语义竞争完成图像命名，但完全缺乏音位编码机制——来推导出可检验的预测：在扰动条件下，患者错误类型应与模型错误在语义阶段类别中对齐，但在音位阶段类别中不应对齐。实验基于LLaVA 1.6（Vicuna-13B）模型，在88名失语症患者对175个费城命名测试项目进行约3700万次命名尝试的基础上，进行了50种扰动种子的分析，结果显示八个错误类别中有六个在项目层面表现出显著一致性（斯皮尔曼等级相关系数ρ = 0.32–0.50，全部p < 0.001），而两个音位类错误（形式错误与抽象错构词）则无显著对齐（ρ = 0.110 和 0.084，均不显著），从而证实了预期的分离效应。通过对输出概率分布进行谱分析，每个错误类型在六维空间中被定位至独特位置，提供了可解释的机制工具。该分离效应具有层特异性（峰值位于第22层，占总深度55%）、与病情严重程度无关，并在不同扰动种子间高度稳定（分半相关r = 0.998）。进一步对四个其他7B规模的VLMs进行权重扰动测试，亦获得了相似量级的正确率对齐（ρ = 0.21–0.27），表明该现象并非特定模型或规模所致。最终结论支持语义-词法与音位编码在人类词汇生成中为可分离的加工阶段，且其分离特征可通过大规模预训练模型的架构属性进行有效建模与验证。

作者: Yong Yang,Roger Newman-Norlund,Xiang Guan,Saeed Ahmadi,Regan Willis,Nadra Salman,Kalil Warren,Sophie Arheix-Parras,Srihari Nelakuditi,Rutvik H. Desai,Leonardo Bonilha,Christopher Rorden,Julius Fridriksson

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The computational architecture of human word production – whether semantic-lexical retrieval and phonological encoding constitute dissociable processing stages – has been debated for decades using hand-designed models with small vocabularies. We introduce computational architectural dissociation: using known architectural properties of vision-language models (VLMs) to derive falsifiable predictions about which patient error types should and should not align with model errors under perturbation. Because VLMs perform picture naming through learned semantic competition over full vocabularies but lack phonological encoding entirely, perturbation-induced errors should match patient patterns for semantic-stage categories but not phonological ones. Testing LLaVA 1.6 (Vicuna-13B) against 88 patients with aphasia across 175 Philadelphia Naming Test items (~37 million naming attempts, 50 perturbation seeds), we find that six of eight error categories show significant item-level alignment (Spearman \rho = 0.32-0.50, all p 0.001) while the two phonological categories – formal errors and abstruse neologisms – show no alignment ( \rho = 0.110 and 0.084, both n.s.), confirming the predicted dissociation. Spectral analysis of the output probabilities places each error type at a distinct position in a six-dimensional space, giving a mechanistic interpretability tool. The dissociation is layer-specific (peaking at L22, 55% depth), severity-independent, and stable across seeds (split-half r 0.998). Weight perturbation of four additional 7B VLMs spanning the tested architectural combinations produced correct-rate alignment of comparable magnitude ( \rho = 0.21-0.27). Whether the per-category dissociation itself depends on scale or on attention design requires a comparison within a single inference implementation, which is reported separately.

[NLP-209] OmniTag-LLM : Multilingual Multitask Speech Tagging

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大模型（Multimodal LLMs）在跨语言语音理解任务中缺乏统一评估与联合建模能力的问题，尤其针对现有基准测试仍以孤立方式评估各子任务且主要聚焦英语的局限性。其核心挑战在于如何实现从单一音频片段中端到端地联合完成语音转录、情感识别、说话人性别判断、语言识别（Language Identification, LID）及词级别命名实体识别（Named Entity Recognition, NER），并确保在多语言场景下的准确性和鲁棒性。解决方案的关键在于提出OmniTag-Bench——一个涵盖五种语言（英语、德语、西班牙语、法语、意大利语）的统一基准测试框架与训练方案，支持“单个音频输入，输出包含所有信息的JSON对象”的联合理解范式，并配套设计了标准化的提示模板与评分器。实验表明，通过LoRA微调的Qwen3-Omni模型在命名实体识别、情感分析和词错误率（WER）上显著提升，尤其在独立标注的情感数据集上性能近乎翻倍，验证了跨任务知识迁移的有效性；此外，该模型还展现出对未见相关语言（如荷兰语）的良好泛化能力，凸显了其在多语言联合建模中的潜力。研究同时开源了全部提示、评分工具与标注流程，为后续研究提供可复现的基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18589
作者: Aref Farhadipour,Francesco Verdini,Antonis Asonitis,Pierre-Edouard Honnet,Marzieh Razavi,Vijeta Avijeet,Juan Pablo Zuluaga Gomez
机构: AGIGO; University of Zurich(苏黎世大学); University of Rome(罗马大学); ETH Zurich(苏黎世联邦理工学院)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal LLMs promise to replace the traditional cascade of specialist speech models with a single system that, from one audio clip, jointly transcribes and labels emotion, gender, language, and named entities. Yet most benchmarks still score these tasks in isolation, and largely in English. We introduce OmniTag-Bench, a five-language benchmark (en/de/es/fr/it) and training recipe for joint understanding: one audio clip in, one JSON object out (transcript, emotion, gender, LID, token-level NER). We evaluate ten open multimodal LLMs and a LoRA fine-tuned Qwen3-Omni on a unified prompt and scorer. Beyond aggregate scores, OmniTag-Bench reveals a systematic failure mode: several strong models often transcribe or translate non-English speech into English, inflating multilingual WER. Fine-tuning improves the base model on NER, emotion, and WER while nearly doubling accuracy on independent human-labeled emotion corpora, suggesting transferable gains beyond pseudo-label imitation. The fine-tuned model also generalizes to unseen but related languages, transferring to held-out Dutch. We release prompts, the scorer, and the labeling pipeline.

[NLP-210] Quantize Qualify Rerank: A Recipe for Compressing LLM s Without Losing Quality

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在推理服务中因模型规模庞大而导致的高成本问题，特别是在模型压缩过程中如何有效评估和维持翻译质量的关键挑战。其核心问题是：单一自动评估指标可能无法准确捕捉模型压缩带来的细微质量损失，导致评估结果失真。为应对这一问题，研究提出以人类元评估（human meta-evaluation）为指导，采用多指标协同验证策略——将MetricX24-XXL作为主要评估指标，CometKiwi-XXL作为交叉验证手段，从而缓解单个指标的偏差。解决方案的关键在于通过结构化剪枝（移除未使用的视觉模块与非任务词汇）、混合精度计算（int8权重或fp8激活）实现高效压缩，同时避免显著性能下降；对于更激进的int4量化，虽存在微小残余损失，但通过Cometoid基于T=0.3温度参数的“最佳4选一”重排序器进行后处理优化，显著提升了8位与4位系统在WMT25测试集上的表现。最终，在无参考（reference-free）评估下，压缩后的模型仍能保持与原始bf16版本相当的竞争力，且不同重排序方案间的微小差异被合理视为噪声，验证了整体方法的有效性与鲁棒性。

机构: Microsoft(微软)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Compressing large language models lowers serving cost, but a single automatic metric may miss quality loss. For the WMT26 Model Compression constrained track, we compress google/gemma-3-12b-it (24.4 GB in bf16) for three translation directions on one H100. Paired bootstrap analysis exposes metric disagreement on 4-bit quantization; guided by WMT24 human meta-evaluation, we use MetricX24-XXL as primary and CometKiwi-XXL as a cross-check. Removing the unused vision stack and non-task vocabulary and using int8 weights or fp8 activations causes no resolved loss, whereas int4 leaves a small residual. QLoRA healing overfits its calibration domain. A Cometoid best-of-4 reranker at T=0.3 improves both the 8-bit and 4-bit systems under WMT25 test set. On post-submission WMT26, both remain competitive with bf16 under reference-free metrics; the small difference between the reranked variants is treated as noise.

[NLP-211] Human vs Machine Translation Detection: A Cross-Model Cross-Domain and Low-Resource Analysis

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）训练中因依赖网络爬取语料而引发的数据质量问题，特别是机器翻译（Machine Translation, MT）内容被误当作人类翻译（Human Translation, HT）使用所带来的风险，尤其在低资源语言场景下更为显著。其核心挑战在于如何有效区分MT与HT文本，以避免合成伪影的传播并保障数据质量。解决方案的关键在于系统评估不同模型架构在跨语言、跨领域和跨翻译源条件下的检测性能：研究发现，仅采用解码器的大型语言模型在零样本或少样本设置下表现有限，且存在明显的类别不对称性——对人类写作内容识别准确率高（高HT召回率），但难以检出流畅的机器翻译输出（低MT召回率）。相比之下，基于编码器的微调模型在特定训练域（如立法文本）内可实现高精度检测，但在面对未见过的译者或新领域（如低资源对话文本、医学内容）时，其对机器翻译的召回率急剧下降。为提升泛化能力，研究提出将长文本按最多300个词元（token）分块处理，显著改善了模型在多场景下的检测效果，表明句子级特征不足以支撑鲁棒的检测能力。此外，通过COMET与BLEURT等指标分析翻译质量与可检测性的关系，发现低质量机器翻译更容易被识别，而高质量机器翻译仍难以与人类翻译区分。综上，该研究强调输入粒度、译者泛化能力以及翻译质量在构建跨语言、跨领域稳健的机器翻译检测系统中的关键作用。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18586
作者: Yabsera Yemanberhan,Prasenjit Mitra,Roald Eiselen
机构: Centre for Text Technology, North-West University (北西大学文本技术中心); Carnegie Mellon University Africa (卡内基梅隆大学非洲校区)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 20 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The growing reliance on web-crawled corpora for training large language models introduces a critical challenge: machine-translated (MT) content is often treated as human translation (HT), potentially degrading data quality and propagating synthetic artifacts, especially in low-resource settings. In this work, we study MT-HT detectability across high-resource (English, Spanish) and low-resource (Swahili, Afrikaans) languages using both decoder-only LLMs in zero-shot and few-shot settings, and fine-tuned multilingual encoders trained at the sentence level and on token-chunked inputs. We find that decoder-only models provide limited discrimination overall and exhibit a consistent class-asymmetric failure mode: they recognize human-written text reliably (high HT recall) but rarely flag fluent machine output (low MT recall). Encoder-based classifiers achieve high accuracy when evaluated on data generated by the same MT systems and translators used during training in a legislative domain, but their MT recall drops sharply on unseen translators and on unseen domains such as low-resource conversational text and medical content. To address this limitation, we evaluate models on longer inputs by chunking text into segments of up to 300 tokens, which substantially improves generalization, suggesting that sentence-level signals are insufficient for robust detection. Finally, we analyze the relationship between translation quality and detectability using COMET and BLEURT, showing that lower-quality MT is more easily identified, while high-quality MT remains difficult to distinguish from HT. Our results highlight the importance of input granularity, translator generalization, and translation quality in building robust MT detection systems across domains and languages.

[NLP-212] Read Route Patch: Robust Test-Time Evolution for LLM Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的智能体在长时程交互决策中因信息瓶颈导致的性能受限问题。具体而言，现有方法存在三大缺陷：记忆检索过度依赖文本相似性、候选行为策略常出现行为冗余、全量策略重写可能覆盖有效证据或引入组件间不一致性。为应对上述挑战，论文提出Trident框架，其核心解决方案包括：基于边界感知的记忆读取机制以提升经验利用效率；基于多样性感知的候选路由策略以增强行为探索多样性；基于顺序感知的插入式更新方法以实现策略演化的稳定性与一致性。实验结果表明，在涵盖文本游戏、网页交互和代码生成任务的五个基准测试上，Trident在qwen-32B、mistral-small-3.2-24B和gpt-oss-20B三种模型架构下均取得最优平均表现，相较于最强基线APEX分别实现30.7%、30.8%和38.3%的相对性能提升。消融实验与敏感性分析进一步验证了三项设计具有互补性且对参数变化具有鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18585
作者: Kaijie Chen,Liang Yan,Yilan Wei,Jiachen Luo,Zhihao Dou,Jiashu Qu,Haoran Liu,Junli Wang
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 13 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents can improve long- horizon interactive decision-making through test-time evolu- tion, yet existing methods face three information bottlenecks: memory retrieval overemphasizes textual similarity, candi- date harnesses are often behaviorally redundant, and whole- harness rewriting may overwrite useful evidence or introduce cross-component inconsistency. We introduce Trident, which improves experience utilization, behavioral exploration, and harness evolution through boundary-aware memory reading, diversity-aware candidate routing, and order-aware insertion- based updating, respectively. We evaluate Trident on five benchmarks spanning text games, web interaction, and cod- ing tasks. Across qwen-32B, mistral-small-3.2-24B, and gpt- oss-20B, Trident achieves the best average performance and consistently outperforms non-learning, memory-based, reflection-based, and automated prompt optimization base- lines. Compared with the strongest baseline, APEX, Trident yields relative average gains of 30.7%, 30.8%, and 38.3% on the three backbones, respectively. Ablation and sensitivity stud- ies further show that the three designs provide complementary gains and remain robust to parameter variations.

[NLP-213] “I Am Not a Kiddo!”: Quantifying Epistemic Infantilization in Large Language Models via Multi-Metric Bias Analysis

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在专业知识服务场景中因用户身份披露（特别是残疾身份）而引发的“认知幼稚化”（epistemic infantilization）问题，即当用户在提出专家级问题前披露自身残疾状况时，模型倾向于降低技术深度、简化内容，从而导致其知识获取能力被系统性削弱。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个反事实数据集，通过对比三种情境下模型响应：无身份背景、对话上下文中披露残疾、以及通过短查询前缀披露残疾，量化该效应。研究引入两个复合指标——认知幼稚化偏差指数（Infantilization Bias Index, IBI）与认知可及性响应评分（Epistemic Accessibility Response Score, EARS），综合评估模型在数学与形式化内容保留、领域术语使用、推理覆盖度及语气信号（如简化标记、主动降级提议）等方面的表现。结果表明，五种开源大模型均呈现显著的去专业化趋势，尤其在物理与数学领域，且该效应在考虑重复测量结构后依然稳健。研究揭示了一种“包容性税”现象：残障用户需更明确地请求严谨内容才能获得与非残障用户同等的知识深度。最终主张，真正的可访问性应体现为格式适配而非内容简化，以保障所有用户在认知层面的平等权利。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18583
作者: Aditya Upadhyay,Arpan Verma,Chandan Sah,Dev Utkarsh,Harshit Gupta
机构: IIIT Delhi (印度信息科学技术研究所)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for tutoring and professional knowledge retrieval, yet safety evaluations still focus mainly on overt harms such as toxicity while overlooking benevolent failure modes. We study epistemic infantilization, defined as an identity-conditioned reduction in technical depth that appears when disability disclosure precedes an expert-level query. To measure this effect, we construct a counterfactual dataset of matched question-answer pairs and compare model responses across three settings: no identity context, disability disclosed in prior conversational context, and disability disclosed via a short query prefix. We introduce two composite metrics, the Infantilization Bias Index (IBI) and the Epistemic Accessibility Response Score (EARS), which capture retention of mathematical and formal content, domain terminology, reasoning coverage, and tone signals such as simplification markers and unsolicited offers to adjust the level. Across five open-weight model families, we find consistent evidence that disability disclosure reduces epistemic access by replacing formal explanations with higher-level summaries, with Physics and Mathematics most affected. Using question-clustered inference that respects the repeated-measures structure of the data, the effect remains reliable after accounting for correlated observations. These findings suggest an inclusion tax, where disabled users must request rigor more explicitly than non-disabled users. We conclude by arguing that accessibility should mean format adaptation rather than content simplification.

[NLP-214] VidEngram: Agent ic Long-Term Video Understanding via Structured Hierarchical Memory

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长视频问答（long-video question answering）中因多轮查询需重复编码视频而导致的计算冗余与信息丢失问题。现有方法受限于上下文长度，不得不对视频进行稀疏采样或截断，且无法保留可复用的表示以支持后续查询。其核心解决方案是提出VidEngram——一种基于代理（agentic）架构的视频问答系统，关键在于在视频摄入阶段一次性构建持久化的分层记忆结构：通过Qwen2.5-Omni联合生成视频与音频的描述，将片段级记忆整合为剧集层与实体层，并利用仅依赖文本的代理规划器结合专用检索工具生成有依据的答案。该设计实现了“感知一次、问答多次”的高效模式，显著降低后续查询的计算开销。实验表明，在完整的OmniVideoBench基准上，采用GPT-5-mini规划器的VidEngram优于单次遍历的Qwen2.5-Omni基线（37.0% vs. 32.3%），尤其在长视频场景下优势更为明显，验证了其在处理长序列内容时的优越性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18578
作者: Zinuo Cheng,Yueqian Lin,Zhongxi Wang,Hai “Helen” Li,Yiran Chen
机构: Duke University (杜克大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multimedia (cs.MM)
备注: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Demo video and code are linked in the paper

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-video question answering is wasteful and lossy when a multimodal model must re-encode the same video for every query: context limits force sparse sampling or truncation, and no reusable representation remains for later questions. We present VidEngram, an agentic video QA system that builds a persistent hierarchical memory once at ingest and answers later questions from that memory. VidEngram captions video and audio jointly with Qwen2.5-Omni, consolidates segment memories into episode and entity layers, and uses a text-only agentic planner with specialized retrieval tools to produce grounded answers. The web interface makes this process inspectable: users can watch memory formation, inspect retrieval traces, verify cited evidence in the video player, and explore entity relationships. On the full OmniVideoBench, VidEngram with a GPT-5-mini planner outperforms a strong single-pass Qwen2.5-Omni baseline (37.0% vs. 32.3%), with gains concentrated on longer videos where single-pass coverage becomes sparse. Because perception is paid once, subsequent queries use low-cost text-only planning.

[NLP-215] ChartSync: A Benchmark for Visuo-Logical Cascading Chart Editing

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式图像编辑模型在处理结构化统计图表时，因数据修改需保持几何同步而面临的挑战，尤其聚焦于跨模态的视觉-逻辑级联编辑（Visuo-Logical Cascading Editing, VLCE）问题。现有方法普遍局限于局部文本替换，难以实现依赖感知的级联更新。为系统评估该能力，研究提出ChartSync——一个基于程序化渲染管道构建的专家验证基准，确保真实标签中视觉与逻辑的一致性（visuo-logical coupling）。ChartSync包含870个三元组，覆盖9类图表和4种任务类型，其中235个实例专门测试文本到几何的级联同步能力。研究采用双层评估框架，结合客观视觉指标与视觉-语言模型判别机制，综合评估低层级保真度及多模态理解与推理能力。对14个图像编辑模型及1个代码中介流程的评估揭示了显著的能力差距：多数开源模型在几何同步方面表现严重退化，仅有两个前沿专有模型展现出初步的VLCE能力，其残余错误主要源于语义孤立与背景污染。通过深入错误分析，研究识别出未来多模态架构应具备的核心元能力。相关数据集与代码已公开发布。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10301
作者: Jiakang Yu,Yixuan Chai,Tianci Wang,Rihui Jin,Guangkai Xu,Hongtao Deng,Xun Zhu,Wang Gao,Xinrun Guo,Haipang Wu
机构: Jianghan University(江汉大学); HiThink Research; University of Science and Technology of China(中国科学技术大学); Southeast University(东南大学); Zhejiang University(浙江大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative image editing models struggle with structured statistical charts when data modifications require geometric synchronization. We formalize this task as Visuo-Logical Cascading Editing (VLCE). However, existing methods remain confined to localized text substitutions and struggle with dependency-aware cascading updates. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce ChartSync, an expert-validated benchmark constructed via a programmatic rendering pipeline that guarantees deterministic visuo-logical coupling for the ground truth. ChartSync comprises 870 triplets across 9 chart categories and 4 task types, including 235 geometry-coupled VLCE instances that specifically test cascading text-to-geometry synchronization. We further evaluate these instances via a two-tier framework combining objective visual metrics with a vision-language model judge paradigm to assess low-level fidelity alongside multimodal comprehension and reasoning. Evaluating 14 image editing models and one code-mediated pipeline reveals a nuanced capability gap: most open-source models suffer severe drops in geometric synchronization, while only two frontier proprietary models show emerging VLCE capability, with their residual errors mainly involving semantic isolation and background corruption. Our detailed error analysis deconstructs these failure paradigms to identify core meta-abilities for guiding future multimodal architectures. The ChartSync dataset and code are publicly released at this https URL.

[NLP-216] Fast Catch-Up Late Switching: Optimal Batch Size Scheduling via Functional Scaling Laws ICLR2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模深度学习训练中批量大小调度（Batch Size Scheduling, BSS）的理论基础薄弱问题，尤其关注在固定数据预算下如何实现最优的批量大小动态调整。其核心挑战在于理解不同任务难度对最优调度策略的影响，并揭示其背后的优化机制。解决方案的关键在于引入功能缩放律（Functional Scaling Law, FSL）框架，该框架为分析BSS提供了理论依据。研究发现，任务难度显著影响最优调度结构：对于简单任务，最优策略是全程逐步增大批量大小；而对于复杂任务，最优策略则是在训练早期保持小批量，仅在后期阶段切换至大批量。这一“晚期切换”现象由一种称为“快速追上效应”（fast catch-up effect）的动力学机制所解释——当从大批量切换后，损失函数迅速趋近于恒定大批量的轨迹，其收敛速度由任务难度决定。该效应源于梯度噪声的快速遗忘，表明大批量可安全延迟至训练后期，从而大幅降低数据消耗而不牺牲性能。通过涵盖密集模型与混合专家（MoE）架构、参数量达11亿、训练数据高达1万亿标记的大量语言模型预训练实验，验证了理论预测：所有场景下，晚切换调度均显著优于恒定批量和早切换基线。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14208
作者: Jinbo Wang,Binghui Li,Zhanpeng Zhou,Mingze Wang,Yuxuan Sun,Jiaqi Zhang,Xunliang Cai,Lei Wu
机构: Peking University (北京大学); Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); University of Science and Technology of China (中国科学技术大学); Meituan (美团), Beijing AI for Science Institute (北京人工智能科学研究院)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Optimization and Control (math.OC); Machine Learning (stat.ML)
备注: 34 pages, accepted by ICLR 2026 as a conference paper

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Batch size scheduling (BSS) plays a critical role in large-scale deep learning training, influencing both optimization dynamics and computational efficiency. Yet, its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. In this work, we show that the functional scaling law (FSL) framework introduced in Li et al. (2025a) provides a principled lens for analyzing BSS. Specifically, we characterize the optimal BSS under a fixed data budget and show that its structure depends sharply on task difficulty. For easy tasks, optimal schedules keep increasing batch size throughout. In contrast, for hard tasks, the optimal schedule maintains small batch sizes for most of training and switches to large batches only in a late stage. To explain the emergence of late switching, we uncover a dynamical mechanism – the fast catch-up effect – which also manifests in large language model (LLM) pretraining. After switching from small to large batches, the loss rapidly aligns with the constant large-batch trajectory. Using FSL, we show that this effect stems from rapid forgetting of accumulated gradient noise, with the catch-up speed determined by task difficulty. Crucially, this effect implies that large batches can be safely deferred to late training without sacrificing performance, while substantially reducing data consumption. Finally, extensive LLM pretraining experiments – covering both Dense and MoE architectures with up to 1.1B parameters and 1T tokens – validate our theoretical predictions. Across all settings, late-switch schedules consistently outperform constant-batch and early-switch baselines.

[NLP-217] he Sharpness Disparity Principle in Transformers for Accelerating Language Model Pre-Training ICML2025

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）预训练过程中不同网络模块间学习动态不均衡的问题，特别是由于各构建模块（如嵌入层、归一化层、自注意力机制和前馈网络等）在优化过程中的曲率差异（Sharpness Disparity）导致的训练效率瓶颈。其核心解决方案是提出**分块学习率（Blockwise Learning Rate, Blockwise LR）**策略，该策略根据每个模块的固有曲率特性动态调整学习率，从而实现更高效的参数更新。关键在于识别并利用早期训练阶段即显现且贯穿始终的模块间曲率差异，通过为不同模块分配适配其优化特性的学习率，显著降低最终损失并实现接近2倍的训练加速。该方法可无缝集成至AdamW及内存高效的Adam-mini优化器中，同时在多个主流模型（GPT-2、LLaMA）与数据集上验证了其有效性，展现出在提升训练效率与降低显存消耗方面的双重优势。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.19002
作者: Jinbo Wang,Mingze Wang,Zhanpeng Zhou,Junchi Yan,Weinan E,Lei Wu
机构: Peking University (北京大学); Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Center for Machine Learning Research, Peking University (北京大学机器学习研究中心); AI for Science Institute, Beijing, China (北京科学智能研究院)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Optimization and Control (math.OC); Machine Learning (stat.ML)
备注: 21 pages, accepted by ICML 2025

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Transformers consist of diverse building blocks, such as embedding layers, normalization layers, self-attention mechanisms, and point-wise feedforward networks. Thus, understanding the differences and interactions among these blocks is important. In this paper, we uncover a clear Sharpness Disparity across these blocks, which emerges early in training and intriguingly persists throughout the training process. Motivated by this finding, we propose Blockwise Learning Rate (LR), a strategy that tailors the LR to each block’s sharpness, accelerating large language model (LLM) pre-training. By integrating Blockwise LR into AdamW, we consistently achieve lower terminal loss and nearly 2\times speedup compared to vanilla AdamW. We demonstrate this acceleration across GPT-2 and LLaMA, with model sizes ranging from 0.12B to 2B and datasets of OpenWebText, MiniPile, and C4. Finally, we incorporate Blockwise LR into Adam-mini (Zhang et al., 2024), a recently proposed memory-efficient variant of Adam, achieving a combined 2\times speedup and 2\times memory saving. These results underscore the potential of exploiting the sharpness disparity to improve LLM training.

[NLP-218] Using the Tsetlin Machine to Learn Human-Interpretable Rules for High-Accuracy Text Categorization with Medical Applications

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决医疗文本分类中高准确率与可解释性之间的矛盾问题。传统深度学习方法虽在准确性上取得显著提升，但牺牲了模型的可解释性，难以满足医疗领域对决策透明性的要求。为此，论文首次引入近期提出的有限状态机（Tsetlin Machine），提出一种基于命题逻辑的文本分类新方法：将文本中的词汇表示为命题变量，并利用简单的合取公式（如“若出现‘皮疹’、‘反应’和‘青霉素’，则判定为过敏”）来建模类别特征。该方法不仅能够利用正向词项进行分类，还可通过否定特征（即未出现的词项）增强分类能力。实验结果表明，在20 Newsgroups、IMDb及一个非公开临床数据集上的对比测试中，Tsetlin Machine在准确率、召回率和精确率方面均优于或持平于朴素贝叶斯、决策树、线性支持向量机（SVM）、随机森林、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）等主流方法。此外，其基于GPU的实现相较CPU版本提速5至15倍。因此，该研究的关键在于通过可解释的符号逻辑机制实现了高性能与可解释性的统一，为医疗文本分析等需要透明决策过程的应用提供了强有力的新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.04547
作者: Geir Thore Berge,Ole-Christoffer Granmo,Tor Oddbjørn Tveit,Morten Goodwin,Lei Jiao,Bernt Viggo Matheussen
机构: 未知

Abstract:Medical applications challenge today’s text categorization techniques by demanding both high accuracy and ease-of-interpretation. Although deep learning has provided a leap ahead in accuracy, this leap comes at the sacrifice of interpretability. To address this accuracy-interpretability challenge, we here introduce, for the first time, a text categorization approach that leverages the recently introduced Tsetlin Machine. In all brevity, we represent the terms of a text as propositional variables. From these, we capture categories using simple propositional formulae, such as: if “rash” and “reaction” and “penicillin” then Allergy. The Tsetlin Machine learns these formulae from a labelled text, utilizing conjunctive clauses to represent the particular facets of each category. Indeed, even the absence of terms (negated features) can be used for categorization purposes. Our empirical comparison with Naïve Bayes, decision trees, linear support vector machines (SVMs), random forest, long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks, and other techniques, is quite conclusive. The Tsetlin Machine either performs on par with or outperforms all of the evaluated methods on both the 20 Newsgroups and IMDb datasets, as well as on a non-public clinical dataset. On average, the Tsetlin Machine delivers the best recall and precision scores across the datasets. Finally, our GPU implementation of the Tsetlin Machine executes 5 to 15 times faster than the CPU implementation, depending on the dataset. We thus believe that our novel approach can have a significant impact on a wide range of text analysis applications, forming a promising starting point for deeper natural language understanding with the Tsetlin Machine.

Abstract:The same molecule can be expressed in multiple, syntactically distinct representations, yet it remains unclear whether large language models (LLMs) can recognize and relate these equivalent encodings. We introduce MolReps, a pipeline that generates 9,600 question-answer pairs across ten representations for conversion, normalization, and 2D structure recognition. Post-training on MolReps improves text-only and multimodal models, MolQwen3-4B-Instruct (MQ3-4B-I) and MolQwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (MQ3-VL-4B-I), from 4.01% to 75.13% and from 7.11% to 73.14% (InChIKey match) on the molecule-overlap test set, respectively. On the molecule-disjoint test set, post-training increased validity from 20.35% to 58.12% for MQ3-4B-I and from 17.19% to 59.34% for MQ3-VL-4B-I. However, InChIKey match remained low, decreasing from 3.86% to 3.09% and from 6.44% to 2.29% , respectively. Furthermore, the resulting models achieve a relative 27.84% improvement in average over their base model on MolRepBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating molecular property prediction. These results show the effectiveness of targeted post-training for enhancing molecular representation understanding and its potential to improve downstream molecular tasks.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In K-12 education, question images combine text, mathematical expressions, diagrams, and diverse layouts. Variations in wording, conditions, answer options, or task scope can substantially alter their reuse utility despite visual similarity. We formulate this problem as directed reuse relevance, grading candidate utility as Strong, Medium, or Weak. However, generic similarity scores overlook task-specific reuse requirements, while natural supervision is dominated by Strong relations and lacks fine-grained coverage. We propose ExRel, an agentic, code-grounded framework for controllable and verifiable visual data synthesis. It reconstructs real questions into editable HTML/CSS seeds and compiles 15 relation subtypes into executable contracts specifying permitted edits, protected invariants, and query-candidate direction. Synthesized pairs undergo deterministic DOM/render validation and target-hidden, evidence-assisted review, with bounded repair before mild photographic degradation. Only rendered images are used for downstream training. Experiments show that ExRel supervision outperforms size-matched natural data and count- and class-matched replay, particularly on Medium relations, while maintaining comparable query-level ranking performance and improving robustness to visual degradation. Construction ablations demonstrate higher valid yield and fewer false admissions than less structured baselines. Human audits confirm 98.0% post-admission validity, while ExRel achieves a lower per-accepted-pair cost than outsourced annotation (0.70 vs. 1.10 RMB). Downstream answer routing further demonstrates the practical utility of the synthesized supervision.

Abstract:Music listening is intrinsically tied to emotion, which drifts continuously within a single session. Although modern browsers interface with wearable brain-computer interfaces, recommendation systems remain structured around discrete logs and lack the infrastructure to integrate continuous physiological signals. Furthermore, existing affect-aware models rely on static user profiles and offline training, failing to serve anonymous newcomers without model retraining. We present a web platform that resolves both challenges. Pairing with a consumer electroencephalogram (EEG) headband over Web Bluetooth, the system captures live EEG, mapping frontal alpha asymmetry and arousal index to normalized valence-arousal proxy coordinates on Russell’s circumplex plane. Driven by these coordinates, an affective adapter unifies structurally diverse recommendation backbones under a shared live scoring mechanism. By parameterizing anonymous visitors through a few favorite tracks, the module recommends tracks conditioned on live proxy coordinates. This demonstrates that real-time EEG-derived control signals can steer recommendations without persistent user tables or model retraining.

作者: Fabio Picariello,Salvatore Cipolla,Susanna Bonura,Vito Morreale
类目: Databases (cs.DB); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)

Abstract:LLM-based natural-language interfaces to relational databases are gated by a schema-retrieval step: the generator can only be as good as the slice of schema it is shown. On a database with hundreds of tables, that slice must be selected and the selection is two-sided—omit a needed table and the query becomes unrecoverable, include too many and the irrelevant ones act as noise that degrades the model’s output. When an agentic retriever that lets the model inspect the schema can be too costly or too slow, the fallback is an embedder that ranks tables by cosine similarity and keeps a top-k. This fallback has two weaknesses: a fixed budget is suboptimal question by question, and embedding similarity overlooks foreign-key-linked tables that are necessary for joins. We present Adaptive-Elbow Graph Traversal (AEGT, ElbowHop for short), a property-graph table retriever that addresses both: an adaptive elbow cutoff replaces the fixed budget with a per-question one under a single aggressiveness parameter, and bidirectional foreign-key traversal deterministically recovers the bridge tables embedding similarity misses. We evaluate the retriever on 3 corpora of increasing candidate-pool size (BIRD Mini-Dev queried per database, 3–13 tables; its eleven schemas merged, 74; and a merged Spider-train graph, 546) and isolate the two mechanisms under a per-question budget-matched protocol. Across these settings the adaptive elbow emerges as the dominant mechanism—at matched recall it roughly doubles precision over a fixed budget on the larger pools, the margin widening as the pool grows—while the foreign-key traversal pays off on the join-critical bridge tables dense retrieval cannot reach, in the single-hop tight-budget case. We characterize the method as a low-cost, recall-robust first stage for schema retrieval on which a downstream selection or generation step can build.

Abstract:Enterprise AI can now perform analytics, reporting, and data-driven workflows, yet the data foundations it relies on remain hard to operationalize: business meaning, relationships, metric definitions, and reporting conventions are absent from database schemas and scattered across undocumented systems and tribal knowledge. Ablating the graph changes held-out accuracy by at most one question per database but increases per-query cost 2.3-3.3x and median latency 1.8-3.4x: continually learned semantics drive accuracy, while the graph makes that context efficient to serve.

Abstract:Hybrid dense-sparse vector retrieval combines semantic signals from dense representations with lexical signals from sparse representations, typically ranking items by a query-dependent weighted sum of dense and sparse vector distances. Existing systems commonly search separate dense and sparse vector indexes and rerank the union of their candidates, incurring two retrieval passes and potentially discarding items that rank highly only after the semantic and lexical signals are combined. Constructing a graph-based index directly under a hybrid distance can mitigate this premature candidate loss. However, because varying the hybrid weight alters the underlying neighborhood relationships, a single static graph built at a fixed weight cannot accommodate dynamic query-specific weights. Therefore, we propose a Unified Hybrid Graph (UniGraph), which merges neighbor sets computed at multiple hybrid weights into a single bounded-degree graph index, enabling hybrid vector retrieval with different query-specific weights without index reconstruction. We further develop an adaptive weight-guided search framework that chooses between sparse- and dense-guided entry points according to the query weight, together with a dense-first hybrid distance pruning strategy that avoids unnecessary exact sparse distance computations. Extensive experiments show that UniGraph provides a favorable Recall-QPS trade-off across different query weights. In the mixed-weight setting, UniGraph delivers 27.6%~52.3% higher QPS than the fastest baseline on each dataset at Recall@100 greater than or equal to 0.95. UniGraph has been deployed at scale in Ant Group’s production environment, where hybrid retrieval with query-dependent weights is in strong demand.

Abstract:Generative retrieval replaces nearest-neighbor search with the generation of a document’s semantic ID (SID), so the SID tokenizer bounds what the retriever can recall. Common SID constructions (residual k-means, RQ-VAE, finite scalar quantization, capacity balancing) optimize criteria defined on document embeddings alone and do not control whether a query can still find its relevant documents after quantization. We propose two retrieval-oriented SID tokenizers. CARE-SID (Contrastive-Anchored Residual Encoding for Semantic IDs) quantizes in a retrieval-aligned space: a zero-initialized residual alignment network is trained with a query-document contrastive loss before quantization, an anchor loss and a reconstruction target fixed to the original embedding prevent drift and collapse, and reference-vector rating residual quantization assigns the codes. CARE-LR (CARE with Listwise Reconstruction) then distills, for each training query, the similarity distribution that the original embeddings induce over a candidate list into the SID reconstructions, through a function-preserving layer-resolved head. Both keep a document-only encoding interface. We judge SIDs without training a generator, by row-budget recall in a bucketing view (the partition) and a reconstruction view (the SID with its reconstruction). In offline evaluation on industrial video search data, both tokenizers achieve higher reconstruction-view recall than residual k-means, and CARE-LR improves further on CARE-SID, mainly through the listwise distillation. A comparison of two document embeddings shows that contrastive alignment helps most when the embedding has not been trained on search data, and that the embedding affects SID recall far more than the quantizer. CARE-SID is deployed in the generative retrieval stage of an industrial video search system.

Abstract:Upgrading the embedding model behind a vector index requires re-encoding the corpus. Recent work reuses the old index through adapters or window re-ranking. Across sixteen model pairs on passage and code corpora, plus eleven on Natural Questions (NQ), we find three results. First, reuse never avoids re-encoding: if migration must complete, every strategy eventually encodes every document; reuse only changes when that work is paid and the quality served meanwhile. Second, adapters should be compared with the old model, not only the new one. Of five adapter variants, only same-family LLM bridges beat the old model, and only by a negligible margin. Third, window re-ranking cost can be priced from the old index alone; pre-registered replays on all 8,841,823 passages confirmed the prediction on all three tested pairs. Workload skew also matters: across 36 further pre-registered Zipf replays, the planned family matched on 32. These findings yield three pre-migration rules: whether reuse is worthwhile, which strategy to use, and how deep a window to take. The depth rule priced every window that reached target quality to within 4 parts in 10^5 of the corpus. On NQ, a pre-committed plan selected the family on 10 of 11 pairs and priced every window exactly. Quality inputs transferred less reliably across corpus scale, so the model gap and window quality loss must be measured on the serving index.

Abstract:Multimodal graphs integrate textual and visual attributes with relational structures, providing a rich representation of complex real-world data. To enable the broad applicability and reuse of graph models, it is crucial for models trained on source graphs to generalize to unseen graph domains. However, this is challenging because cross-modal interactions among neighbors and the neighboring information needed for prediction can vary across target nodes and graph domains. This gives rise to two key challenges: adaptive cross-modal neighborhood fusion, which captures and integrates cross-modal interactions among neighbors to accommodate variations across nodes and domains; and target-specific evidence selection, which identifies the neighboring textual and visual information needed for each target node to support LLM-based prediction. In light of these challenges, we propose MAGE (Meta-path Adaptive Graph Evidence Prompting), a framework for transferable multimodal graph learning. MAGE represents textual and visual node views separately in a heterogeneous graph and introduces two complementary components. Meta-path Adaptive Multimodal Propagation (MAMP) adaptively aggregates neighborhood information along heterogeneous meta-paths and compresses it into graph-aware soft tokens. Evidence-Guided Instruction Tuning (EGIT) selects relevant neighboring evidence for each query and incorporates its graph-aware representations into instructions for a frozen multimodal LLM. Together, these components support transfer from multiple source graphs to unseen target graphs without target-domain parameter updates. Experiments with three source graphs and four unseen target graphs demonstrate strong cross-domain transfer performance on node classification and link prediction, without requiring parameter updates on the target domains.

Abstract:Multimodal search with image-text queries helps users find notes in user-generated content (UGC) communities and serves as a key search tool for multimodal search agents. Abstract:Privacy controls can prevent an evaluator from linking purchases to the recommendations users received, while a merchant can still release complete item-level purchase counts for the evaluation cohort. Abstract:A decade after the publication of the FAIR Guiding Principles, what have we learned about data sharing, and what do data availability statements (DAS) and other materials accrued over that period tell us about how data-sharing practices, attitudes, and infrastructures evolved? Here, we present a large-scale longitudinal analysis of over 6.8 million biomedical articles from the PMC Open Access Subset, spanning 2011 to 2025. Using an automated pipeline, we extracted and classified DAS, repository links, accession numbers, and supplementary materials, assigning each article a data-sharing score and independently FAIR-assessing a subset of cited dataset URLs. We find that explicit DAS adoption rose from ~2% in 2011 to 68% in 2025, while “available on request” statements grew in parallel from near zero to over 19%. The corpus growth amplifies both patterns: articles with a DAS containing an explicit repository mention rose from 132 in 2011 to 94,697 in 2025, while “available on request” articles rose from 77 to 173,474 over this span. Structural biology and genomics consistently achieved the highest data-sharing scores, while clinical research and public health ranked lowest. Gold Open Access journals showed a small advantage over subscription journals, while Diamond Open Access journals outperformed both. Internationally collaborative articles scored higher than domestic ones. A gender gap emerged: female first-authored articles’ scores declined more than male first-authored ones. The analysis further covered additional dimensions, from compliance with funder/journal mandates and JATS XML tagging standards to computational reproducibility signals and the co-occurrence of DAS with ethics statements. A decade on, the gap between declaring data availability and actually sharing machine-readable, reusable data persists across fields, infrastructures and demographics.

Abstract:This work aims to make recommendation agents more efficient by reducing unnecessary LLM reflection while preserving full-catalog ranking and inference reranking. Privacy risks can be controlled with the same protections required by the base recommendation agent: minimizing user text sent to the LLM controller, anonymizing user identifiers, retaining only necessary interaction evidence, and applying standard access-control and logging policies. Overall, BRAVE is designed as a cost-aware allocation layer, and its ethical deployment depends on validating that the saved computation does not come at the expense of vulnerable users or responsible exposure. Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as recommenders in e-commerce and conversational shopping systems, where they select a product from a set of retrieved candidates described in natural language. Detecting such structural biases is difficult because relevance labels are rarely available. We propose a label-free framework to audit LLM-based recommender systems for structural bias. Candidate descriptions are rewritten by randomly assigned paraphrasing models and presented in random order. We prove that, if the recommender’s choice is invariant to these rewritings, every paraphraser is selected with equal probability, yielding a statistical test that requires no relevance labels. A four-step statistical pipeline tests this property and quantifies the contribution of each description feature while controlling for query-product relevance. We apply the framework to verbosity bias on 20,000 product queries and nine recommender LLMs from five model families. After controlling for the measured relevance signals, description length has a positive effect on selection in all nine models, increasing the odds of selection by up to 38% per standard deviation of length. Relevance remains the primary driver of recommendations, while verbosity acts as a consistent secondary signal whose strength depends on the model family. Since the framework needs only black-box access and no annotations, it can be run as a routine audit of deployed shopping assistants, and we provide an auditing protocol with cost and sample-size guidance.

Abstract:For multi-hop queries in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), it is crucial to accurately obtain evidence pieces. Instead of generating intermediate reasoning text, the method extracts the bridging clue from the internal attention of the embedding model based on the current context and retrieved candidate documents. During iterative clue extraction and document retrieval, IN-Retriever strips away revealed clues from the embedded query vector and then reranks candidate documents in a targeted manner, thereby steering retrieval toward hidden next-hop evidence. In the experiments, we confirm the feasibility and effectiveness of using intrinsic attention signals to guide external multi-hop retrieval. Experimental results show that our method precisely collects sufficient documents to support multi-hop queries and significantly outperforms sparse and dense retrieval methods.

Abstract:Scientific literature is expanding rapidly, yet much of its knowledge remains difficult to organize and reuse due to the substantial workload needed to navigate large, heterogeneous literature corpora. We benchmarked 11 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight LLMs across three materials science screening tasks differing in scope, corpus size, and class imbalance. Seven LLMs achieved balanced accuracies above 0.90 across all tasks, with the best-performing LLM reaching 0.96–0.98, demonstrating the potential of LLMs to accurately screen large, highly imbalanced scientific corpora. The framework also substantially reduces manual effort, screening 10,000 records within four minutes compared with approximately 83 person-hours for manual screening. Beyond literature screening, the framework extracts structured information from full-text articles, enabling content-level quantification of research landscapes that extends traditional bibliometric analysis based on publication metadata. This capability reveals methodological trends and underexplored directions, as shown for machine learning in concrete materials science. We further demonstrate its utility for information and data discovery by identifying publications containing silicate glass density data that are difficult to retrieve using conventional search strategies, which can support downstream hypothesis development, research design, and data-driven scientific discovery. Overall, these results demonstrate the broad applicability of LLM-powered literature analysis across scientific domains and its potential to transform large, unstructured literature corpora into structured, analyzable knowledge at scale.

Abstract:Transmitting semantically structured embedding vectors over digital channels is costly in bit rate, while conven- tional vector quantization approaches face limitations in scalabil- ity, encoding complexity, and index assignment. Abstract:Background: AI systems are increasingly deployed to support mental health clinicians, yet real-world evidence remains limited. In crisis counseling, where clients often seek human connection, understanding whether AI augmentation preserves or undermines meaningful human engagement is essential. Methods: In a mixed-methods study of a counselor-facing AI copilot on a WhatsApp-based crisis hotline in India (Mar.-Oct. 2025), counselors could request, edit, and send AI messages. We analyzed 20 interviews, 8 shadowing sessions, 56 survey responses, and edits in 27,778 copilot messages from 108 counselors via thematic analysis (Technology Acceptance Model 2, plus inductive coding of emergent factors), and survey statistics. Results: Counselors reported high copilot acceptance (survey): 98.2% found it helpful; 89.3% likely to continue use; 80.4% reported efficiency gains. Interviews highlighted sentence scaffolding, empathetic phrasing, stress reduction, catching missed details, and efficiency. Barriers (survey) included repetitive outputs (23.2%), lack of context (17.9%), and authenticity concerns (10.7%). While 69.6% (survey) reported skill enhancement, interviews surfaced skill atrophy concerns. Counselors frequently accepted copilot suggestions, editing to remove questions, adjust tone, or personalize style. Conclusion: In one of the largest real-world deployments of a counselor-facing mental health AI copilot, counselors reported reduced cognitive load, empathetic communication, and greater efficiency, alongside concerns about skill atrophy, authenticity, and over-reliance. In settings like crisis counseling where clients seek human connection, AI tools must balance operational support with preserving clinical skill and genuine therapeutic engagement. Designs soliciting approval or editing of complete drafts may overweight efficiency at the expense of sustained human engagement. Abstract:AI systems for creative media generation expand human capabilities yet risk diminishing human agency. We propose pre-generation belief controls that can empower creators to inspect, revise, and steer the AI’s interpretation before any media is generated, so that the initial anchor is set by the human. We formalize four design principles and instantiate them in the Proactive Co-Creator (PaCC), a system for early-stage conceptual ideation and prototyping that proactively surfaces its assumptions and uncertainty through clarifications, belief graphs, and media attributes, inviting users to shape the AI’s beliefs before generating the final outcome. Abstract:As symptom checkers based on artificial intelligence (AI) are becoming common entry points for health information, their influence on lay users’ diagnostic decisions raises questions about trust and bias. Of particular concern is confirmation bias, the tendency to favour information that supports one’s existing belief while discounting information that contradicts it. One of the central design choices for such systems is the style of voice: whether they should present themselves with a human-like (anthropomorphic) or a clearly machine-like (xenomorphic) voice. In a within-subjects online experiment (N = 81 participants, 648 trials), participants selected a diagnosis and rated their confidence, then heard an AI-generated recommendation that either confirmed or contradicted their initial choice, delivered by an anthropomorphic or a machine-like voice, before deciding again. We observed a strong, direction-dependent influence of the AI: participants revised their diagnosis in 45.7% of trials when the AI contradicted them versus 1.2% when it confirmed them (generalised linear mixed model, GLMM, p .001); confidence rose under confirmation but barely moved under contradiction (robust linear mixed model, p .001); and decisions took longer after contradiction (Gamma GLMM, p .001). This effect did not differ between the two voices (no voice or interaction term was significant, smallest p = .282), even though a manipulation check confirmed the voices were perceived as markedly different. The findings suggest that the direction of an AI recommendation, rather than the anthropomorphism of its voice, drives confirmation-related bias in AI-assisted self-diagnosis.

Abstract:Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) express implicit biases in high-publicity, one-off decision scenarios such as hiring and intelligence assessment. Next, in a crowdsourced audit, 500 participants made 8,010 binary choices about which implicitly biased decision scenarios most deserved further review. We found that participants prioritized decision scenarios that had broad relevance (e.g., about food choices), were high stakes (e.g., about health), and where all members of a simulated sociodemographic group made unanimous decisions (because it was a clear indication of stereotyping). When examining the rationale behind their prioritization choices, we found that participants often interpreted disparities as traits of demographic groups and judged whether those traits seemed plausible, often based on their own internalized stereotypes. We discuss implications for building personalized AI agents, digital twins, social simulations, and for using crowdsourced bias audits.
